senses.english: a person between the ages of 13 and 19
senses.exampleEnglish: As a teenager, Mina kept a journal because she wanted to understand how her opinions were changing.
senses.exampleChinese: 十几岁时，米娜坚持写日记，因为她想了解自己的观点如何变化。

senses.english: to feel respect or wonder toward someone
senses.exampleEnglish: I admire people who admit their mistakes instead of blaming others when a project goes wrong.
senses.exampleChinese: 我钦佩那些项目出错时承认错误而非责怪他人的人。

senses.english: to look at something with pleasure because it is beautiful or impressive
senses.exampleEnglish: We stopped to admire the mountain view before continuing along the narrow path towards the next village.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们停下来欣赏山景，然后沿窄路继续前往下一个村庄。

senses.english: average in size or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide recommended a moderate pace so that everyone could finish the walk without becoming exhausted.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游建议保持适中的速度，以便大家都能走完全程而不至于筋疲力尽。

senses.english: having opinions or actions that are not extreme
senses.exampleEnglish: Her moderate views allowed her to work with people who disagreed strongly about how the town should develop.
senses.exampleChinese: 她温和的观点让她能与对城镇发展意见严重不同的人合作。

senses.english: to make something less strong, extreme, or severe
senses.exampleEnglish: The chair asked both speakers to moderate their language so that the discussion could continue without personal attacks.
senses.exampleChinese: 主席要求两名发言者措辞温和些，让讨论继续而不出现人身攻击。

senses.english: to guide a discussion or check that shared content follows agreed rules
senses.exampleEnglish: An experienced volunteer will moderate the discussion, making sure everyone has a chance to speak without being interrupted.
senses.exampleChinese: 有经验的志愿者会主持讨论，确保每个人都有不受打断的发言机会。

senses.english: a person whose political or other views are not extreme
senses.exampleEnglish: The proposal appealed to moderates who wanted gradual changes rather than either keeping everything or replacing the whole system.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项提案吸引了主张逐步改变的温和派，他们既不想维持全部现状，也不想替换整个体系。

senses.english: medical treatment in which a doctor cuts into a body
senses.exampleEnglish: Although her surgery went well, she arranged extra help at home while she gradually regained her strength.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然手术很顺利，她仍安排人在家帮忙，让自己逐渐恢复体力。

senses.english: a place where a doctor or dentist sees patients, especially in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: I called the doctor's surgery before leaving home to check whether my appointment had been moved to the afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 出门前我打电话给诊所，确认预约是否已改到下午。

senses.english: a person who writes, sings, or plays music, as a job
senses.exampleEnglish: The musician explained how regular practice helped her feel confident even when she performed before large audiences.
senses.exampleChinese: 那位音乐家解释了规律练习如何帮助她即使面对众多观众演出也保持自信。

senses.english: importance of something; the potential for something to have a big effect
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not understand the significance of the old photographs until our grandmother explained their history.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到祖母讲述了那些老照片的来历，我们才明白它们的重要意义。

senses.english: the meaning that something has or suggests
senses.exampleEnglish: The students discussed the significance of the final scene, explaining how it changed their understanding of the main character.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生讨论最后一幕的含义，解释它如何改变了他们对主人公的理解。

senses.english: the cleaning of a body by standing under falling water
senses.exampleEnglish: After cycling home through the rain, Leo took a hot shower before preparing dinner for his family.
senses.exampleChinese: 冒雨骑车回家后，利奥先洗了个热水澡，再为家人准备晚餐。

senses.english: a short period of rain
senses.exampleEnglish: We waited in a small café until the shower passed, then continued our walk around the old harbour.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在小咖啡馆等阵雨过去，然后继续绕着老港口散步。

senses.english: to wash yourself under falling water
senses.exampleEnglish: After the muddy football match, everyone wanted to shower before sitting down to the meal our hosts had prepared.
senses.exampleChinese: 泥泞中的足球赛结束后，大家都想先淋浴，再坐下吃主人准备的饭。

senses.english: to give someone many things or make many things fall over them
senses.exampleEnglish: The audience showered the young performers with praise after they completed a difficult scene without losing their confidence.
senses.exampleChinese: 年轻演员自信地完成困难场景后，观众纷纷称赞他们。

senses.english: a large number of small things falling through the air together
senses.exampleEnglish: A shower of leaves fell from the branches when a sudden wind passed through the quiet garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 一阵风穿过安静花园时，枝头的树叶纷纷落下。

phrases.chinese: 迎接新生儿的送礼聚会
phrases.english: a party where people give presents before a baby is born
phrases.exampleEnglish: Her friends organised a baby shower at home, choosing a quiet afternoon when relatives could meet and share their good wishes.
phrases.exampleChinese: 朋友在家办迎婴聚会，选安静下午让亲友见面送祝福。

senses.english: not allowed by the laws or rules
senses.exampleEnglish: The notice warned that parking outside the entrance was illegal because emergency vehicles needed clear access.
senses.exampleChinese: 告示警告入口外停车属于违法行为，因为应急车辆需要畅通出入。

senses.english: organization providing help to the needy, the sick
senses.exampleEnglish: Our class chose a local charity that provides books for children whose families cannot afford them.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们班选择了一家为买不起书的家庭中的孩子提供图书的当地慈善机构。

senses.english: the activity of helping people in need, especially by giving money or goods
senses.exampleEnglish: The concert raised money for charity, allowing local families to enjoy music while supporting people who needed practical help.
senses.exampleChinese: 音乐会为慈善筹款，让当地家庭欣赏音乐的同时支持需要实际帮助的人。

senses.english: kindness in the way you judge or treat other people
senses.exampleEnglish: A little charity towards new members can make the club more welcoming, especially when they misunderstand an unfamiliar rule.
senses.exampleChinese: 对新成员多一点宽容能让俱乐部更友善，尤其在他们误解不熟悉规则时。

senses.english: done or experienced by everyone
senses.exampleEnglish: Although customs differ across countries, the desire to feel safe and respected seems almost universal everywhere.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然各国习俗不同，但希望感到安全并受到尊重的愿望似乎几乎普遍存在。

senses.english: designed to work with many different devices, systems, or situations
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop recommended a universal adapter because we would be using our equipment in several different countries during the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店推荐通用转换插头，因为旅途中我们会在几个不同国家使用设备。

senses.english: a small paper tube filled with tobacco
senses.exampleEnglish: He put out his cigarette before entering the building, where smoking was forbidden to protect other visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 他进入大楼前熄灭了香烟，因为楼内为保护其他访客而禁止吸烟。

senses.english: to make up or be part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: These three short interviews constitute the main evidence that the students will discuss in their final report.
senses.exampleChinese: 这三段简短访谈构成了学生将在最终报告中讨论的主要证据。

senses.english: to be considered or treated as a particular thing
senses.exampleEnglish: Arriving late once does not constitute a serious problem, but repeated delays can make the whole team's work difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 一次迟到不算严重问题，但反复拖延会让整个团队工作困难。

senses.english: enough; good enough for what is needed
senses.exampleEnglish: Before the outdoor event begins, we must check that there is adequate shelter if the weather changes.
senses.exampleChinese: 户外活动开始前，我们必须检查天气变化时是否有足够的遮蔽场所。

senses.english: expert who gives (paid) advice
senses.exampleEnglish: The school hired a consultant to suggest practical improvements after teachers reported problems with the new system.
senses.exampleChinese: 教师反映新系统存在问题后，学校聘请了一位顾问提出切实可行的改进建议。

senses.english: someone who studies or writes about the course of history
senses.exampleEnglish: A local historian showed us letters that revealed how ordinary families lived more than a century ago.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位当地历史学家向我们展示了一些信件，揭示一个多世纪前普通家庭的生活。

senses.chinese: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
senses.english: a child of your uncle or aunt
senses.exampleEnglish: My cousin offered to show us around the city because she had lived there since starting university.
senses.exampleChinese: 我的表姐主动提出带我们游览这座城市，因为她从上大学起就住在那里。

senses.english: something to look at with the eyes
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher used visual examples to explain the process before asking students to describe it in their own words.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先用直观的示例解释这个过程，再让学生用自己的话描述。

senses.chinese: 图片；视觉材料（常用复数）
senses.english: a picture or other image used to support a message or presentation
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker used clear visuals to explain the process, so even people unfamiliar with the subject could follow her argument.
senses.exampleChinese: 发言者用清晰图像解释流程，因此不熟悉主题的人也能理解她的论述。

senses.english: lacking the ability to learn easily; not intelligent
senses.exampleEnglish: Calling someone stupid after a mistake can discourage them from asking questions when they need help.
senses.exampleChinese: 别人犯错后骂其愚蠢，可能使他们在需要帮助时不敢提问。

senses.english: being eager or excited for something to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: Maya was keen to join the photography club because she wanted to learn how to capture moving subjects.
senses.exampleChinese: 玛雅很想加入摄影俱乐部，因为她想学习如何拍摄运动中的对象。

senses.english: able to notice or understand things quickly and accurately
senses.exampleEnglish: A keen eye for detail helped the editor spot a small mistake that everyone else had missed in the diagram.
senses.exampleChinese: 编辑敏锐的观察力帮助她发现图中其他人都没注意到的小错误。

senses.english: very strong or intense
senses.exampleEnglish: There was keen competition for places on the course, so applicants were asked to explain their reasons for joining.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程名额竞争激烈，因此要求申请者说明参加理由。

senses.english: connected with people who share a cultural tradition
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival celebrates different ethnic traditions through music and food, encouraging visitors to learn from one another.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个节日通过音乐和食物庆祝不同的民族传统，鼓励访客相互学习。

senses.english: typical of the traditional styles, food, or customs of a cultural group
senses.exampleEnglish: The market sells ethnic clothing made by local craftspeople, who explain the patterns and traditions behind each design.
senses.exampleChinese: 市场售卖当地手艺人制作的民族服饰，他们会解释每种图案和设计背后的传统。

senses.english: two children born from the same mother at the same time
senses.exampleEnglish: Although each twin enjoys different hobbies, they often help one another prepare for important school presentations.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然双胞胎各自喜欢不同的爱好，他们常互相帮助准备重要的学校展示。

senses.english: forming a matching or closely related pair
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel offered a twin room with separate beds, which suited the two friends travelling together for the weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 酒店提供一间两张单人床的双床房，适合周末一起旅行的两位朋友。

senses.english: to form an official friendship between two towns in different countries
senses.exampleEnglish: The council hopes to twin the town with a coastal community abroad so students can exchange ideas about marine life.
senses.exampleChinese: 议会希望该镇与国外沿海社区结为友好城市，让学生交流海洋生物方面的知识。

senses.english: related to the examination and treatment of patients
senses.exampleEnglish: The students observed a clinical examination after the patient had agreed to let them watch and take notes.
senses.exampleChinese: 病人同意学生旁观并记录后，学生们观摩了一次临床检查。

senses.chinese: 冷静客观的；缺少感情的
senses.english: showing little emotion and focusing only on practical facts
senses.exampleEnglish: His clinical description of the damaged garden surprised neighbours who had spent years turning it into a welcoming space.
senses.exampleChinese: 他冷静描述受损花园，令那些多年努力把花园变得宜人的邻居感到惊讶。

senses.english: being in the area to the east
senses.exampleEnglish: We explored the eastern part of the island, where fishing villages overlook a long stretch of quiet coastline.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们游览了岛的东部，那里渔村俯瞰着一段漫长宁静的海岸。

senses.english: a prediction of some future thing (e.g., the weather)
senses.exampleEnglish: The weather forecast predicted strong winds, so we decided to postpone our boat trip until the following morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 天气预报说会有大风，所以我们决定把乘船出游推迟到第二天早晨。

senses.english: to say what is likely to happen in the future using available information
senses.exampleEnglish: Experts forecast a rise in train use after the new timetable makes journeys between the towns more convenient.
senses.exampleChinese: 新时刻表让城镇间出行更方便后，专家预测火车使用量会上升。

senses.english: part divided from the other parts of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Each segment of the documentary focuses on a different family, showing how their daily routines compare.
senses.exampleChinese: 纪录片的每个片段聚焦不同的家庭，展示他们日常生活的异同。

senses.english: what is usual or normal
senses.exampleEnglish: It is a local custom to welcome new neighbours with food, although families choose different dishes.
senses.exampleChinese: 用食物欢迎新邻居是当地习俗，尽管各家选择的菜肴不同。

senses.english: the business that regular customers give a shop or service
senses.exampleEnglish: The small café depends on local custom during winter, when few tourists visit the village beside the lake.
senses.exampleChinese: 冬天很少有游客到湖边村庄，咖啡馆依靠当地顾客光顾。

senses.english: made specially for a particular customer or purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: They ordered custom shelves that fitted the narrow room, allowing them to store books without blocking the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们订制了适合窄房间的架子，可以放书又不挡窗。

senses.english: to change something to fit or suit a new purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The team had to adapt its original plan when heavy rain made the outdoor performance impossible.
senses.exampleChinese: 大雨导致户外演出无法进行时，团队不得不调整原来的计划。

senses.english: to change a book, device, or method so it can be used differently
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will adapt a short story for the stage, deciding which scenes can be shown rather than explained.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生将把短篇小说改编成舞台剧，决定哪些场景能演出来而不靠说明。

senses.english: grains of rock that make beaches and deserts
senses.exampleEnglish: By the time we reached the beach, the afternoon sun had warmed the sand enough for barefoot walking.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到海滩时，午后的阳光已经把沙子晒暖，足以赤脚行走。

senses.english: to rub a surface with rough paper to make it smooth
senses.exampleEnglish: Before painting the shelf, sand the rough edges carefully so that nobody catches their hand on the wood.
senses.exampleChinese: 给架子上漆前，仔细打磨粗糙边缘，防止木头刮到人的手。

senses.english: small, soft hat often with a front visor or shade
senses.exampleEnglish: He wore a bright cap during the school trip so that his friends could easily spot him in crowds.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校出游时他戴着一顶鲜艳的帽子，让朋友们能在人群中轻易找到他。

senses.english: a small cover placed over an opening or object
senses.exampleEnglish: Replace the cap on the bottle after pouring the water, so dust cannot get inside during the walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 倒水后把瓶盖盖回去，防止步行途中灰尘进去。

senses.english: a fixed upper limit on an amount or number
senses.exampleEnglish: The club introduced a cap on group size so that every beginner would receive enough attention from the instructor.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部给小组人数设上限，让每个初学者都能得到教练充分关注。

senses.english: to set a maximum amount or number
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisers will cap attendance at fifty people because the workshop requires enough space for everyone to move safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者会把人数限制为五十，因为工作坊需要让每个人都有安全活动的空间。

phrases.english: used to add one final surprising or unwelcome point
phrases.exampleEnglish: The train was late, the café was closed, and to cap it all, I discovered that my phone battery was empty.
phrases.exampleChinese: 火车晚点，咖啡馆关门，更糟的是我发现手机没电了。

senses.english: being done quickly and with no delay
senses.exampleEnglish: A prompt reply from the hotel allowed us to confirm the booking before the special offer ended.
senses.exampleChinese: 酒店的及时回复让我们得以在优惠结束前确认预订。

senses.english: to make someone take action or make something happen
senses.exampleEnglish: A question from a parent prompted the school to explain more clearly how students were grouped for the new lessons.
senses.exampleChinese: 家长的一个问题促使学校更清楚地解释新课如何给学生分组。

senses.english: to help someone remember what to say or do
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher quietly prompted the nervous actor when he forgot his line, allowing the performance to continue smoothly.
senses.exampleChinese: 紧张的演员忘词时，老师轻声提示，让演出顺利继续。

senses.english: a word, question, or signal that helps someone respond or remember something
senses.exampleEnglish: Use the photograph as a prompt for your story, but choose characters and events that reflect your own ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 把照片作为故事提示，但人物和情节要体现你自己的想法。

senses.english: quality of making people like you; attractiveness
senses.exampleEnglish: Much of the village's charm comes from its narrow streets, where small shops still sell locally made goods.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个村庄的魅力很大程度上来自狭窄街道，那里小店仍出售当地手工产品。

senses.english: a small object worn or carried because it is decorative or believed to bring luck
senses.exampleEnglish: She kept a tiny charm on her bracelet because it reminded her of the friend who had given it to her.
senses.exampleChinese: 她手链上留着一个小饰物，因为它让她想起送礼物的朋友。

senses.english: to make someone like you through pleasant behaviour
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide charmed the visitors with stories about the town, turning an ordinary walk into a memorable afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游用城镇故事吸引游客，把普通散步变成难忘的下午。

phrases.chinese: 非常灵验地；效果极好地
phrases.english: in a way that works very well
phrases.exampleEnglish: The simple repair worked like a charm, and the old lamp was ready before the guests arrived for dinner.
phrases.exampleChinese: 简单修理十分奏效，客人来吃晚饭前旧灯已能用。

senses.english: to behave or make a change in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: People may react differently to the same feedback, depending on how clearly and respectfully it is given.
senses.exampleChinese: 人们对同样的反馈可能反应不同，这取决于反馈表达得是否清楚且尊重对方。

senses.english: to change when substances are brought together
senses.exampleEnglish: In the demonstration, the two substances reacted when mixed, allowing students to observe a change in colour and temperature.
senses.exampleChinese: 演示中两种物质混合后发生反应，让学生观察到颜色和温度变化。

senses.english: talk or speech about a particular subject
senses.exampleEnglish: After the lecture, several students stayed behind to ask how the theory might apply to everyday situations.
senses.exampleChinese: 讲座结束后，几名学生留下来询问这个理论如何用于日常情境。

senses.english: to give a formal talk about a subject
senses.exampleEnglish: She will lecture on local history next month, using family photographs to show how the neighbourhood has changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 她下月会讲地方历史，用家庭照片展示街区如何变化。

senses.english: to tell someone at length why you think their behaviour is wrong
senses.exampleEnglish: Please do not lecture me about being late before hearing why the buses stopped running during the storm.
senses.exampleChinese: 请先听暴风雨中公交停运的原因，再来教训我迟到的事。

senses.english: activity that involves taking chances or risks
senses.exampleEnglish: Opening a small bookshop was a risky venture, but the owners believed the neighbourhood needed a reading space.
senses.exampleChinese: 开一家小书店是一项有风险的创业活动，但店主相信社区需要阅读空间。

senses.english: to go somewhere or say something despite uncertainty or possible danger
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not venture far from the marked path because thick mist made it difficult to recognise the surrounding hills.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们没有冒险远离标记路线，因为浓雾让人难以辨认周围山丘。

senses.english: something that is made from two or more other things
senses.exampleEnglish: In the experiment, students examined a chemical compound that behaved differently from the elements used to make it.
senses.exampleChinese: 实验中，学生观察了一种化合物，其表现与构成它的元素不同。

senses.english: an enclosed area containing a group of buildings
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors must wait outside the school compound until staff confirm that the afternoon activities have finished and children are ready.
senses.exampleChinese: 访客必须在学校围起来的场地外等候，直到工作人员确认下午活动结束、孩子已准备好。

senses.english: made from two or more separate parts
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson explains how a compound word combines two familiar words to create a meaning that may be slightly different.
senses.exampleChinese: 这节课解释复合词如何把两个熟词合成一个意义可能略不同的新词。

senses.english: to make a problem or difficulty worse
senses.exampleEnglish: A lack of clear information compounded the delay, as passengers kept joining the wrong queue at the crowded station.
senses.exampleChinese: 信息不清加重了延误，乘客在拥挤车站不断排错队。

phrases.english: interest calculated on both the original money and previously earned interest
phrases.exampleEnglish: The teacher used a simple table to explain compound interest, showing why the total changes faster over several years.
phrases.exampleChinese: 老师用简单表格解释复利，展示总额为何几年后增长更快。

senses.english: to save something from danger or harm
senses.exampleEnglish: Firefighters managed to rescue the cat after a neighbour noticed it trapped on the roof during heavy rain.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居发现猫被困在大雨中的屋顶上后，消防员成功把它救了下来。

senses.english: an act of saving someone or something from danger
senses.exampleEnglish: The rescue took longer than expected because the path was narrow and the team had to move carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 救援比预期久，因为道路狭窄，队伍必须小心移动。

senses.english: dirty or untidy area
senses.exampleEnglish: The kitchen was such a mess after our first baking attempt that cleaning took longer than cooking.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们第一次尝试烘焙后厨房一片狼藉，清理花的时间比做食物还长。

senses.english: a situation that is confused, badly organised, or difficult to solve
senses.exampleEnglish: The conflicting bookings left the organisers in a mess until someone suggested dividing the event into two separate sessions.
senses.exampleChinese: 预订冲突让组织者陷入困境，直到有人建议把活动分成两场。

senses.english: to make something dirty or untidy
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not mess up the labels while moving the boxes, because we need them to identify the different collections.
senses.exampleChinese: 搬箱子时别弄乱标签，因为我们要靠它们识别不同收藏。

phrases.english: to do something badly or spoil its arrangement
phrases.exampleEnglish: I was worried I might mess up the opening, so my partner suggested practising it once before the audience arrived.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我担心搞砸开头，搭档建议观众来前练一次。

phrases.english: to behave playfully or waste time instead of doing what is needed
phrases.exampleEnglish: There will be time to mess around later, but first we need to put the borrowed equipment safely back in its cupboard.
phrases.exampleChinese: 以后有时间玩闹，先把借来的设备安全放回柜子。

senses.english: something that is liked or wanted more than another
senses.exampleEnglish: Please mention any food preference when booking, so the organisers can arrange suitable meals for everyone attending.
senses.exampleChinese: 预订时请说明饮食偏好，以便组织者为所有参加者安排合适的餐食。

senses.english: including most or all things
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide provides a comprehensive introduction to the city, including transport advice and places beyond the usual tourist routes.
senses.exampleChinese: 这本指南全面介绍了该市，包括交通建议和常规旅游路线之外的地方。

senses.english: something that encourages a person to work hard
senses.exampleEnglish: Offering extra training gave employees an incentive to develop skills instead of focusing only on their current tasks.
senses.exampleChinese: 提供额外培训让员工有动力发展技能，而不只是专注于当前任务。

senses.english: association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members
senses.exampleEnglish: Our school joined a regional league so that students could compete regularly against teams from nearby towns.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们学校加入了地区联赛，让学生能定期与附近城镇的球队比赛。

senses.english: a level of quality or ability compared with others
senses.exampleEnglish: Her careful research put the project in a different league from our first attempt, which had relied mostly on guesses.
senses.exampleChinese: 她细致的研究使项目比主要靠猜测的首次尝试高了一个层次。

phrases.english: working secretly with someone, often for an unfair purpose
phrases.exampleEnglish: In the story, the shopkeeper is in league with the thief, which explains why the missing objects never appear in his records.
phrases.exampleChinese: 故事里店主与贼勾结，因此记录中从未出现失物。

phrases.chinese: 超出我的能力；与我水平悬殊
phrases.english: too difficult or too good for me
phrases.exampleEnglish: At first I thought the course was out of my league, but patient explanations helped me understand the difficult parts.
phrases.exampleChinese: 起初我觉得课程超出能力，但耐心解释让我理解难点。

senses.english: conversation between two or more individuals
senses.exampleEnglish: The short dialog reveals their disagreement without explaining everything, allowing readers to work out each character's concerns.
senses.exampleChinese: 这段简短对话没有说明一切，却揭示了他们的分歧，让读者推断各角色的顾虑。

senses.english: the thick white liquid that comes from milk and is used in cooking
senses.exampleEnglish: She added a little cream to the soup just before serving it, which made the texture smoother.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在上汤前加入少量奶油，使汤的口感更顺滑。

senses.english: a thick substance put on the skin for protection or treatment
senses.exampleEnglish: She packed a small tube of hand cream because cold weather often made her skin feel dry during winter trips.
senses.exampleChinese: 她装了一小管护手霜，因为冬季旅行的冷天气常让皮肤干燥。

senses.english: the best people or things in a group
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition brings together the cream of local photography, showing images selected from hundreds submitted by residents over the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览汇集当地摄影精华，作品从居民一年提交的数百张照片中选出。

senses.english: to mix butter and sugar until they become light and smooth
senses.exampleEnglish: Cream the butter and sugar together before adding the eggs, so the mixture becomes light enough for the cake to rise evenly.
senses.exampleChinese: 加蛋前先把黄油和糖打匀，使混合物轻盈，蛋糕均匀膨起。

senses.english: happening very quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: The rapid growth of the town has created jobs, but local transport services are struggling to keep up.
senses.exampleChinese: 城镇的快速发展创造了就业机会，但当地交通服务难以跟上。

senses.english: to stop a planned event from happening
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to cancel the picnic because the park was closed after strong winds damaged several trees.
senses.exampleChinese: 大风损坏了几棵树，公园因此关闭，我们只得取消野餐。

phrases.english: to balance or remove the effect of something else
phrases.exampleEnglish: The extra fee could cancel out the saving on the ticket, so compare the total cost before choosing the cheaper option.
phrases.exampleChinese: 额外费用可能抵消票价节省，所以选便宜选项前比较总价。

senses.english: to be sorry about something
senses.exampleEnglish: I regret not asking more questions when the instructions were explained, because I misunderstood an important step.
senses.exampleChinese: 我后悔讲解说明时没有多问问题，因为我误解了一个重要步骤。

senses.english: a sad feeling about something you did or did not do
senses.exampleEnglish: Her only regret was missing the final discussion, where the group had compared ideas she wanted to hear more about.
senses.exampleChinese: 她唯一的遗憾是错过最后讨论，大家当时比较了她想进一步了解的想法。

senses.english: to send someone away
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager could not dismiss an employee simply for raising a concern that everyone else had ignored.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理不能仅仅因为一位员工提出了其他人都忽视的顾虑就将其解雇。

senses.english: to decide that an idea, concern, or claim is not worth considering
senses.exampleEnglish: We should not dismiss a suggestion simply because it comes from someone with less experience than the rest of the team.
senses.exampleChinese: 不能仅因提出者比其他队员经验少，就不考虑一个建议。

senses.english: to tell a person or group that they may leave
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher dismissed the class after checking that everyone understood what to prepare before the next lesson began.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师确认大家明白下节课前该准备什么后，让全班下课了。

senses.english: the empty space at the top, bottom, and sides of a written or printed page
senses.exampleEnglish: Leave a wide margin on the left so that your teacher has room to write detailed comments.
senses.exampleChinese: 左侧留出宽边距，让老师有空间写详细评语。

senses.english: the difference between two amounts, results, or levels
senses.exampleEnglish: The team won by a narrow margin, so the coach reminded everyone how important their small improvements had been.
senses.exampleChinese: 队伍以微弱优势获胜，因此教练提醒大家小进步有多重要。

senses.english: the amount by which the selling price is greater than the cost
senses.exampleEnglish: The café's profit margin fell when ingredients became more expensive, although the owner wanted to keep prices affordable.
senses.exampleChinese: 食材变贵后咖啡馆利润下降，但店主仍想维持亲民价格。

senses.english: an extra amount that allows for mistakes or unexpected changes
senses.exampleEnglish: Leave a margin for delays when planning the journey, since the road through the village can become busy.
senses.exampleChinese: 规划行程时留出延误余量，因为村里的道路可能拥堵。

senses.english: under; in or to a lower position; below
senses.exampleEnglish: Beneath the old bridge, we discovered a quiet path that led directly to the river's edge.
senses.exampleChinese: 在老桥下，我们发现一条安静的小路，直接通到河边。

senses.english: not good enough or suitable for someone's position or standards
senses.exampleEnglish: She never considered ordinary cleaning tasks beneath her, even after becoming responsible for managing the entire community centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使负责管理整个社区中心，她也从不认为普通清洁工作有失身份。

senses.english: a person that you are competing against in a game or contest
senses.exampleEnglish: Although her opponent had more experience, Lina stayed calm and changed her approach after the first round.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然对手更有经验，莉娜仍保持冷静，并在第一轮后改变了策略。

senses.english: a person who disagrees with or tries to stop a plan or opinion
senses.exampleEnglish: Opponents of the proposal asked for more evidence before the council approved changes to the busy town centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 提案反对者要求议会在批准繁忙镇中心的改动前提供更多证据。

senses.english: to try to stop or prevent something
senses.exampleEnglish: The old door was designed to resist strong winds, which often sweep across this exposed coastal area.
senses.exampleChinese: 这扇旧门设计得能抵挡强风，而强风经常扫过这片没有遮挡的海岸。

senses.english: to stop yourself from doing something that you want to do
senses.exampleEnglish: I could not resist reading the final page, even though I knew it would reveal the mystery too soon.
senses.exampleChinese: 我忍不住看了最后一页，虽然知道这会太早揭开谜底。

senses.english: means, ability, or potential to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The new software has the capability to compare several reports, although a person must still check the conclusions.
senses.exampleChinese: 新软件能够比较多份报告，但结论仍需人工检查。

senses.english: complete and total
senses.exampleEnglish: Absolute silence was required during the recording, so even the smallest movement had to wait until the break.
senses.exampleChinese: 录音时要求绝对安静，所以连最小的动作也得等到休息时再做。

senses.english: having no limits or restrictions
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide did not have absolute control over the weather, but she could choose safer routes when conditions changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游无法完全控制天气，但情况变化时能选择更安全的路线。

senses.english: to have similarity or equality with something
senses.exampleEnglish: The numbers in your summary should correspond to those in the original report before you send it out.
senses.exampleChinese: 发送摘要前，其中的数字应与原报告中的数字一致。

senses.english: to exchange letters or written messages
senses.exampleEnglish: The two classes correspond regularly by email, sharing descriptions of local customs and asking questions about each other's daily lives.
senses.exampleChinese: 两个班定期通过邮件通信，分享当地习俗并询问对方日常生活。

senses.english: to touch someone or something repeatedly in a caring way
senses.exampleEnglish: The child learned to stroke the rabbit gently after watching how the keeper approached it without causing alarm.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子看护养员如何接近兔子而不惊吓它之后，学会了轻轻抚摸兔子。

senses.english: a sudden medical condition caused by interrupted blood flow to the brain
senses.exampleEnglish: After his stroke, the family worked with professionals to understand which everyday activities he would need support to manage.
senses.exampleChinese: 他中风后，家人与专业人员合作，了解哪些日常活动需要协助。

senses.english: one movement of a hand, brush, tool, or part of the body
senses.exampleEnglish: With each careful stroke of the brush, the artist added another thin layer of colour to the background.
senses.exampleChinese: 画家每小心刷一笔，就给背景添上一层薄薄颜色。

senses.english: a way of swimming or one movement used in swimming
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor asked us to practise the stroke slowly before trying to swim the full length of the pool.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练让我们先慢慢练习划水动作，再试着游完整个泳池。

phrases.english: an unexpected piece of good fortune
phrases.exampleEnglish: Finding the missing key was a stroke of luck, because nobody had thought to look beneath the flowerpot beside the gate.
phrases.exampleChinese: 找到失匙纯属好运，没人想过看门边花盆下。

senses.english: (v) to have enough courage to do (n) something dangerous or difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: She did not dare ask another question until the teacher smiled and encouraged everyone to speak freely.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到老师微笑并鼓励大家畅所欲言，她才敢再提一个问题。

senses.english: to challenge someone to do something difficult or frightening
senses.exampleEnglish: His friend dared him to sing alone, but he chose to wait until he felt comfortable rather than accept the challenge.
senses.exampleChinese: 朋友激他独唱，但他选择等自己准备好，而不是接受挑战。

senses.english: a challenge to do something difficult or frightening
senses.exampleEnglish: She refused the dare to climb the old wall because impressing her friends was not worth the risk.
senses.exampleChinese: 她拒绝爬旧墙的挑战，因为向朋友逞强不值得冒险。

phrases.english: used to say that something is probably true
phrases.exampleEnglish: I dare say the hall will fill quickly, so we should arrive early if we want seats near the front.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我想礼堂会很快坐满，所以想坐前排就该早到。

senses.english: structure or object that stops free movement
senses.exampleEnglish: The fallen tree formed a barrier across the path, forcing walkers to return by a different route.
senses.exampleChinese: 倒下的树形成了横在路上的障碍，迫使步行者改走另一条路返回。

senses.english: something that prevents progress, communication, or participation
senses.exampleEnglish: The evening course removed a language barrier by offering explanations in two languages until learners felt ready to use English alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 晚课先提供双语解释，直到学习者能只用英语，从而消除了语言障碍。

senses.english: to no longer be wanted so you throw it away
senses.exampleEnglish: We finally got rid of the damp smell after opening the windows and replacing the old carpet.
senses.exampleChinese: 打开窗户并更换旧地毯后，我们终于去除了潮湿的气味。

phrases.english: to remove something unwanted or stop having it
phrases.exampleEnglish: We need to get rid of the broken boxes before the workshop, but keep any material that can be reused safely.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作坊前须除掉破箱子，但保留可安全再用的材料。

senses.english: (v) to (n) end a marriage as permitted by law
senses.exampleEnglish: After the divorce, they agreed to discuss important family decisions calmly and keep their children's routines stable.
senses.exampleChinese: 离婚后，他们同意平静地讨论重要家庭决定，并保持孩子们日常生活稳定。

senses.english: to legally end a marriage
senses.exampleEnglish: They decided to divorce after several difficult years, but agreed that important arrangements for their children should remain their shared responsibility.
senses.exampleChinese: 经历几年困难后他们决定离婚，但同意孩子的重要安排仍由双方共同负责。

senses.english: to separate things that are normally connected
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot divorce the building's history from the neighbourhood around it, because both developed through the same changes.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不能把建筑历史与周围街区分开，因为两者经历同样变化而发展。

senses.english: to spoil something, to make it useless
senses.exampleEnglish: Leaving the windows open during the storm could ruin the furniture, so we checked every room before leaving.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴风雨时不关窗可能毁坏家具，因此离开前我们检查了每个房间。

senses.english: the damaged remains of a building, often used in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: We explored the ruins of the old theatre while the guide explained how people once gathered there for celebrations.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们参观旧剧院废墟，导游解释人们过去如何在那里聚会庆祝。

senses.english: the loss of money, success, or value
senses.exampleEnglish: The failed harvest brought the small business close to ruin, until neighbours helped find another source of supplies.
senses.exampleChinese: 歉收使小企业濒临破产，后来邻居帮忙找到了其他货源。

senses.english: to put something into the ground and cover it
senses.exampleEnglish: The children decided to bury a small box in the garden and open it again five years later.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们决定把一个小盒子埋在花园里，五年后再打开。

senses.english: to cover something deeply or put it where it is difficult to find
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were buried in a long email, so several volunteers missed the change to the meeting time.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明埋在一封长邮件里，导致几个志愿者没注意集合时间已变。

phrases.phrase: bury your head in the sand
phrases.english: to avoid accepting or dealing with an obvious problem
phrases.exampleEnglish: Do not bury your head in the sand when the plan stops working; ask the group what needs to change.
phrases.exampleChinese: 计划失灵时不要逃避，问小组该改什么。

senses.english: (v) to listen and give (n) expert advice to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Experienced volunteers counsel new arrivals who feel uncertain about finding their way around an unfamiliar city alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 有经验的志愿者为新来者提供咨询，帮助那些不确定如何独自适应陌生城市的人。

collocations.chinese: 就问题向某人提供咨询

senses.english: careful advice, especially from someone with experience or professional knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: She sought counsel from an experienced teacher before deciding how to deal with the disagreement within her class.
senses.exampleChinese: 她向经验丰富的老师征求建议，再决定如何处理班里的分歧。

senses.english: a lawyer who gives legal advice or represents someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee sought legal counsel before signing the agreement, because members wanted to understand their responsibilities if the event had to be cancelled.
senses.exampleChinese: 签约前委员会征求法律意见，想明白活动取消时的责任。

senses.english: quality that something happens or someone behaves in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: He has a tendency to speak too quickly when excited, so he practises pausing between important points.
senses.exampleChinese: 他兴奋时往往说得太快，因此练习在重点之间停顿。

senses.english: happening often
senses.exampleEnglish: Frequent changes to the timetable confused passengers, especially those who relied on the last bus to get home.
senses.exampleChinese: 时刻表频繁变动让乘客困惑，尤其是依靠末班车回家的人。

senses.english: a machine that uses energy to make something work or move
senses.exampleEnglish: The small motor stopped working halfway through the demonstration, so we explained the remaining steps using a diagram.
senses.exampleChinese: 小马达在演示中途停止运转，于是我们用图解说明剩下的步骤。

senses.english: relating to the movement and control of muscles
senses.exampleEnglish: The activity develops motor skills by asking children to move small objects carefully, while also encouraging them to explain the pattern they are making.
senses.exampleChinese: 活动让孩子小心移动小物件发展动作技能，也鼓励解释图案。

senses.english: act of continuing to exist when facing difficulty
senses.exampleEnglish: During the dry season, access to a reliable water source is essential for the survival of many animals.
senses.exampleChinese: 旱季时，获得可靠水源对许多动物的生存至关重要。

senses.english: a long, flat surface in a shop or kitchen where work is done; a device that counts
senses.exampleEnglish: Please leave the parcel on the counter while I look for the reference number you will need.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把包裹放在柜台上，我来查找你需要的编号。

senses.english: to respond to something with an opposing action or argument
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker countered the criticism by showing records that explained why the project had taken longer than expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 发言者展示记录反驳批评，解释项目为何比预期耗时更长。

senses.english: in a direction or way that opposes something else
senses.exampleEnglish: The decision runs counter to the school's promise to give every student an equal chance to join the club.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项决定违背了学校让所有学生都有平等入社机会的承诺。

senses.english: a device that counts how often something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The counter records how many people enter the library, helping staff decide when more volunteers are needed at the desk.
senses.exampleChinese: 计数器记录入馆人数，帮助工作人员判断柜台何时需更多志愿者。

phrases.chinese: 不用处方地；直接在柜台上
phrases.english: available from a shop without a doctor's prescription
phrases.exampleEnglish: The leaflet explains which products are sold over the counter and reminds customers to ask a qualified professional if they have questions.
phrases.exampleChinese: 说明解释哪些产品非处方出售，并提醒有疑问时询问专业人员。

phrases.english: sold secretly or illegally rather than openly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The documentary describes goods sold under the counter when official supplies were limited, explaining why authorities struggled to keep track of them.
phrases.exampleChinese: 纪录片描述官方供应有限时私下卖货，解释监管为何难追踪。

senses.english: to have or own something
senses.exampleEnglish: Applicants do not need to possess advanced computer skills, but they should be willing to learn new methods.
senses.exampleChinese: 申请者不必拥有高级计算机技能，但应愿意学习新方法。

senses.english: right to do something as allowed by another
senses.exampleEnglish: We asked for permission to photograph the workshop before using any pictures in our school project online.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们先申请获准拍摄工作坊，才在学校项目的线上展示中使用照片。

senses.english: long, low area between hills or mountains, often with a river running through it
senses.exampleEnglish: Morning mist filled the valley, hiding the river until the sun rose above the surrounding hills.
senses.exampleChinese: 晨雾弥漫山谷，遮住了河流，直到太阳升到周围群山上方。

senses.english: (n) a device (v) to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink
senses.exampleEnglish: The children watched leaves float down the stream while comparing how quickly different shapes moved through the water.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们看着树叶顺溪漂流，并比较不同形状的叶子在水中移动的速度。

senses.english: a small supply of cash kept for giving customers change
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers checked the cash float before the fair opened, making sure they could give change to the first customers.
senses.exampleChinese: 集市开门前志愿者核对备用零钱，确保能给首批顾客找零。

senses.english: to suggest an idea for other people to consider
senses.exampleEnglish: She floated the idea of an evening workshop, hoping that people who worked during the day could finally attend.
senses.exampleChinese: 她提出开夜间工作坊的想法，希望白天工作的人终于能参加。

senses.english: an object that stays on the surface of water or supports something there
senses.exampleEnglish: The child held a swimming float while practising kicks, with the instructor close enough to provide help immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子抱着浮板练习踢水，教练就在旁边以便随时帮忙。

senses.chinese: 很生气的；特别喜欢；疯狂的
senses.english: very angry, very strong feelings, crazy
senses.exampleEnglish: He was mad at himself for missing the bus, although leaving earlier would have solved the problem.
senses.exampleChinese: 他因错过公交车而生自己的气，尽管早点出门本可以解决这个问题。

senses.english: very enthusiastic about something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her brother is mad about trains and spends weekends drawing the different engines he sees at the local railway station.
senses.exampleChinese: 她弟弟痴迷火车，周末画下在当地车站见到的各种机车。

senses.english: extremely foolish, unreasonable, or uncontrolled
senses.exampleEnglish: It would be mad to attempt the whole journey without checking whether the last bus actually serves that village.
senses.exampleChinese: 不核实末班车是否到那个村就走完全程，会非常不明智。

phrases.english: to become extremely upset, uncontrolled, or excited
phrases.exampleEnglish: The crowd seemed ready to go mad with excitement when the young team returned carrying the trophy into the school hall.
phrases.exampleChinese: 年轻队伍捧杯回校礼堂时，观众兴奋得几乎疯狂。

senses.english: very much
senses.exampleEnglish: Your advice greatly improved my presentation because it helped me organise the examples in a clearer order.
senses.exampleChinese: 你的建议极大改善了我的展示，因为它帮我更清晰地组织了例子。

senses.english: easily seen or understood
senses.exampleEnglish: The village was barely visible through the fog, although we could still hear the church bell ringing.
senses.exampleChinese: 雾中几乎看不见村庄，但我们仍能听到教堂钟声。

senses.english: using a particular type of energy carried through metal wire
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose an electric cooker for the new kitchen because the building did not have a gas supply.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们为新厨房选了电灶，因为这栋楼没有燃气供应。

senses.english: full of strong excitement
senses.exampleEnglish: The atmosphere was electric when the young musicians returned for one final song after the audience's long applause.
senses.exampleChinese: 观众长时间鼓掌后，年轻乐手返场再唱一首，现场气氛激动人心。

senses.english: something makes someone admire or respect
senses.exampleEnglish: Her final design was particularly impressive because she had solved a difficult problem using only simple materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的最终设计格外令人钦佩，因为她仅用简单材料便解决了一个难题。

senses.english: slow, steady change or development
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition traces the evolution of bicycles, showing how each design responded to changes in people's needs.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览追溯自行车的演变，展示每种设计如何回应人们需求的变化。

senses.english: having knowledge of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The campaign aims to raise awareness of food waste by showing families how much they throw away each week.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项活动展示家庭每周丢弃多少食物，旨在提高人们对食物浪费的认识。

senses.english: knowledge of what is happening around you or how you feel
senses.exampleEnglish: The exercise encourages awareness of small changes in sound, helping students listen carefully before describing what they have heard.
senses.exampleChinese: 练习鼓励察觉声音细微变化，帮助学生先仔细听，再描述听到的内容。

senses.english: done with force; likely to cause physical damage
senses.exampleEnglish: A violent storm damaged the harbour overnight, leaving several small boats unable to sail the next morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 一场猛烈风暴在夜间破坏了港口，导致几艘小船第二天早晨无法出航。

senses.english: someone who is legally owned by another person
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum explains how a slave could be denied basic freedoms and why people fought to end slavery.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆说明奴隶如何被剥夺基本自由，以及人们为何为废除奴隶制而斗争。

phrases.english: to work extremely hard for a long time
phrases.exampleEnglish: You do not need to slave away all evening; dividing the work now will give everyone a reasonable time to rest.
phrases.exampleChinese: 不必整晚苦干，现在分工就能让大家合理休息。

senses.english: having a great amount of money or property
senses.exampleEnglish: A wealthy resident paid for the library repairs so that the whole community could continue using the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位富裕的居民出资修缮图书馆，使整个社区能够继续使用这栋建筑。

senses.english: design and construction of buildings
senses.exampleEnglish: Studying the city's architecture helped us understand how its buildings had changed as different communities settled there.
senses.exampleChinese: 研究该市的建筑设计帮助我们了解，不同群体定居后建筑如何发生变化。

senses.english: satisfactory; good enough
senses.exampleEnglish: The first draft was acceptable, but the teacher suggested adding evidence to make the argument more convincing.
senses.exampleChinese: 初稿尚可，但老师建议补充证据，让论点更有说服力。

senses.english: a written record of subjects or events
senses.exampleEnglish: Keeping a travel journal helped me remember conversations and small details that photographs could not capture alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 写旅行日志帮我记住了谈话和细节，那些是单靠照片无法捕捉的。

senses.english: a magazine containing research or professional information about a particular subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The article appeared in a science journal before the researchers explained their findings in simpler language for the general public.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章先发表于科学期刊，随后研究者再用更浅显语言向公众解释发现。

senses.english: dark hard substance from the earth burnt as a fuel
senses.exampleEnglish: The town once depended on coal, but many former mine buildings now provide space for small businesses.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个城镇曾依赖煤炭，但许多原来的矿区建筑如今为小企业提供场地。

senses.english: the finding of the size or amount of something or someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Check each measurement twice before cutting the wood, since a small error could affect the whole frame.
senses.exampleChinese: 切割木材前将每项尺寸测量核对两遍，因为小误差可能影响整个框架。

senses.english: chosen or done without a plan or pattern
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a random sample of comments so that the review would not reflect only the strongest opinions.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们随机抽取了一些评论，让评审结果不会只反映最强烈的意见。

phrases.english: without a plan or deliberate selection
phrases.exampleEnglish: Choose three comments at random before reading the most popular ones, so your first impression is not shaped only by the strongest opinions.
phrases.exampleChinese: 先随机选三条评论再读热门，避免初印象只受强烈意见影响。

senses.english: in a manner that achieves a goal
senses.exampleEnglish: The students successfully completed the challenge after dividing the work according to each person's strongest practical skills.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生根据各自最擅长的实际技能分工后，成功完成了挑战。

senses.english: to make someone feel very sad; to reduce the value of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Several disappointing results began to depress him, so he took a break before deciding what to try next.
senses.exampleChinese: 几次令人失望的结果开始使他沮丧，于是他先休息，再决定接下来尝试什么。

senses.english: to reduce a price, amount, or level of activity
senses.exampleEnglish: Poor transport connections can depress demand for local services, since visitors may choose places that are easier to reach.
senses.exampleChinese: 交通联系不便可能压低当地服务需求，因为访客可能选择更容易到达的地方。

senses.english: picture that helps explain something
senses.exampleEnglish: The illustration beside the instructions shows how the pieces fit together, making the task easier to understand.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明旁的插图展示零件如何拼合，使任务更容易理解。

senses.english: an example that makes a point clearer
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher used the changed timetable as an illustration of how a small decision can affect many people's daily routines.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师用时刻表的变动作例证，说明小决定如何影响许多人的日常生活。

senses.english: (v) to break or open in (n) a sudden and surprising way
senses.exampleEnglish: The balloon suddenly burst during the rehearsal, making everyone jump before they realised what had caused the noise.
senses.exampleChinese: 气球在排练中突然爆了，大家都吓了一跳，随后才明白响声的来源。

senses.english: a short and sudden period of activity, sound, or emotion
senses.exampleEnglish: A burst of applause followed the final song, surprising the performers who had worried that the audience might not enjoy it.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一首歌后响起一阵掌声，让原本担心观众不喜欢的表演者很惊喜。

phrases.english: to suddenly begin crying
phrases.exampleEnglish: She tried not to burst into tears when the letter arrived, because it confirmed she could finally visit her family after several years.
phrases.exampleChinese: 信确认多年后终于可探亲，她努力忍住不突然哭出。

phrases.english: to suddenly start laughing
phrases.exampleEnglish: We could not help but burst out laughing when the actor's hat fell off, although he continued the scene without hesitation.
phrases.exampleChinese: 演员帽子掉了我们忍不住突然大笑，他却毫不迟疑继续演。

senses.english: advantage or right that is given to only a certain person or group of people
senses.exampleEnglish: Using the archive is a special privilege, so visitors must handle the original documents with particular care.
senses.exampleChinese: 使用档案馆是一项特别权限，因此访客必须格外小心地处理原始文件。

senses.english: a valuable or unusual opportunity that makes you feel lucky
senses.exampleEnglish: It was a privilege to hear the artist explain the painting herself, especially after studying her work for several months.
senses.exampleChinese: 能听画家亲自讲解作品是一种荣幸，尤其在研究她的作品数月之后。

senses.english: someone who gets something by paying money for it
senses.exampleEnglish: The buyer asked several questions about the bicycle's condition before deciding whether the price was reasonable.
senses.exampleChinese: 买方询问了几个有关自行车状况的问题，然后才决定价格是否合理。

senses.english: shared between two or more people
senses.exampleEnglish: Their friendship developed through a mutual interest in gardening, although they had very different backgrounds and careers.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们虽然背景和职业截然不同，但因对园艺的共同兴趣发展出友谊。

senses.english: long, thin piece of metal or wood
senses.exampleEnglish: Hold the rail as you climb the narrow stairs, especially when carrying bags that block your view.
senses.exampleChinese: 上狭窄楼梯时请握住扶手，尤其是在拎着挡住视线的包时。

senses.english: railways and travel by train
senses.exampleEnglish: Travelling by rail allowed us to read during the journey instead of concentrating on traffic along unfamiliar roads.
senses.exampleChinese: 坐铁路让我们途中能阅读，而不必注意陌生道路上的车流。

senses.english: to complain angrily and at length about someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents continued to rail against the confusing system after several promised improvements failed to make the application process any clearer.
senses.exampleChinese: 几项承诺的改进未让申请流程更清楚，居民继续愤怒抱怨这个混乱系统。

phrases.english: out of control or no longer developing as planned
phrases.exampleEnglish: The discussion went off the rails when people began arguing about old complaints instead of the question everyone had agreed to answer.
phrases.exampleChinese: 人们争论旧怨而非约定问题时，讨论失控了。

senses.english: to make someone excited about doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: Clear goals can motivate learners to practise regularly, particularly when they can see small improvements over time.
senses.exampleChinese: 明确目标能激励学习者规律练习，尤其当他们能看见逐步的小进步时。

senses.english: a place for doing research and experiments
senses.exampleEnglish: Before entering the laboratory, students put away their food and listened carefully to the teacher's safety instructions.
senses.exampleChinese: 进入实验室前，学生收起食物，仔细听取老师的安全说明。

senses.english: (v) to take out (n) a long-term loan from a bank for buying property
senses.exampleEnglish: They compared several mortgage offers before choosing one whose monthly payments fitted comfortably within their household budget.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们比较了几种抵押贷款方案，才选出月供在家庭预算承受范围内的一种。

senses.english: to borrow money using a property as security
senses.exampleEnglish: They did not want to mortgage the house to support the shop, because the family's financial security mattered more.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们不愿抵押房屋支持商店，因为家庭财务安全更重要。

senses.english: moving someone to a more important position
senses.exampleEnglish: Her promotion brought more responsibility, including training new staff and making decisions that affected the whole department.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的晋升带来更多责任，包括培训新员工和作出影响整个部门的决定。

senses.english: activity intended to make people interested in a product, event, or idea
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum's summer promotion attracted families who had never visited before, especially when they discovered the free children's activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆夏季宣传吸引了从未来过的家庭，尤其是他们发现有免费儿童活动后。

senses.english: powerful, positive feeling about something
senses.exampleEnglish: His passion for music kept him practising after work, even when progress seemed slower than he had hoped.
senses.exampleChinese: 他对音乐的热情让他下班后仍坚持练习，即使进步似乎比预期慢。

senses.english: person who fights for or supports strongly
senses.exampleEnglish: As a champion of equal access to education, she worked to make the library welcoming to every family.
senses.exampleChinese: 作为平等教育机会的支持者，她努力让图书馆欢迎每一个家庭。

senses.english: a person or team that wins a competition
senses.exampleEnglish: The local champion returned to the club to practise with younger players and share what she had learned.
senses.exampleChinese: 本地冠军回到俱乐部与年轻球员练习，分享自己的经验。

senses.english: to actively support a cause or person
senses.exampleEnglish: She continues to champion free access to books because she believes every child should have a welcoming place to read.
senses.exampleChinese: 她持续支持免费获取图书，因为她认为每个孩子都应有宜人的阅读场所。

senses.english: to do something that was promised or required
senses.exampleEnglish: The new reading room will fulfill a promise made to residents when the old library closed last year.
senses.exampleChinese: 新阅览室将兑现去年旧图书馆关闭时向居民作出的承诺。

senses.english: fine dry powder that builds up on surfaces
senses.exampleEnglish: A layer of dust covered the shelves because nobody had entered the spare room for several months.
senses.exampleChinese: 架子上积了一层灰，因为几个月来没人进过这个备用房间。

senses.english: to remove dust from a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: We dusted the empty shelves before returning the books, taking care not to damage the labels on the older volumes.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们先擦净空架子的灰尘再放回书，注意不损坏旧书标签。

senses.english: to cover a surface with a thin layer of powder
senses.exampleEnglish: Dust the cake with a little sugar before serving it, keeping the decoration simple so the fruit remains visible.
senses.exampleChinese: 上蛋糕前撒少许糖，装饰保持简单，让水果仍能看见。

phrases.english: to remain unused or forgotten for a long time
phrases.exampleEnglish: We did not want the donated equipment to gather dust, so volunteers arranged short sessions showing people how to use it.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们不想捐赠设备闲置，因此志愿者安排短课教人使用。

phrases.english: to fail, stop working, or be defeated
phrases.exampleEnglish: The old printer may finally bite the dust if it breaks again, because repairing it now costs more than replacing it.
phrases.exampleChinese: 旧打印机再坏可能就报废，因为维修已比换新贵。

senses.english: to give your energy, time, etc., completely to someone
senses.exampleEnglish: She decided to dedicate an hour each evening to writing, rather than waiting for a completely free day.
senses.exampleChinese: 她决定每晚花一小时专心写作，而不是等整天空闲才写。

senses.english: to say that a book or other work is for a particular person
senses.exampleEnglish: The writer chose to dedicate her first book to the teacher who encouraged her when she doubted her ability.
senses.exampleChinese: 作家把第一本书献给曾在她怀疑能力时鼓励她的老师。

senses.english: in an inexact or imprecise manner
senses.exampleEnglish: The journey takes roughly two hours, although traffic near the bridge can make it longer during busy periods.
senses.exampleChinese: 这段路程大约需要两小时，但繁忙时段桥边的车流会使时间延长。

senses.english: in a forceful or careless way without being gentle
senses.exampleEnglish: The parcel had been handled roughly during delivery, so we checked every item before agreeing that nothing was damaged.
senses.exampleChinese: 包裹运输时遭粗暴搬运，因此我们检查每件物品才确认没有损坏。

senses.english: piece of clothing for the lower body worn by women
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose a simple skirt for the interview because she wanted to feel comfortable rather than distracted.
senses.exampleChinese: 她为面试选了一条简单的裙子，因为她想保持自在，不让衣着分散注意力。

senses.english: to avoid dealing directly with a difficult issue or obstacle
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker tried to skirt the question about costs, but several listeners asked for a clear explanation before agreeing.
senses.exampleChinese: 发言者想回避费用问题，但几名听众要求先清楚解释才同意。

senses.english: area that a country or nation is divided into
senses.exampleEnglish: Each province has its own regional dishes, which makes travelling across the country an interesting experience for food lovers.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个省都有自己的地方菜，这使全国旅行成为美食爱好者的有趣体验。

senses.english: (v) to walk with (n) regular steps as a group
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will march through the town together before gathering in the square for the annual celebration.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生将一起列队走过城镇，然后在广场集合参加年度庆典。

senses.english: an organised walk by a group for a public purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The peaceful march ended outside the town hall, where residents handed in a request for better public transport.
senses.exampleChinese: 和平游行在市政厅外结束，居民递交了改善公共交通的请求。

senses.english: the third month of the year, written March
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition opens in March, when visitors can also enjoy the first spring flowers in the gardens beside the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览三月开放，那时游客还能欣赏博物馆旁花园里的第一批春花。

senses.english: judgment about the value or condition of something
senses.exampleEnglish: A careful evaluation of the pilot project helped us decide which activities were worth offering to more schools.
senses.exampleChinese: 认真评估试点项目后，我们确定了哪些活动值得向更多学校推广。

senses.english: (v) to make (n) an agreement in which each side must give up some things
senses.exampleEnglish: Both groups were willing to compromise once they understood why the proposed changes mattered to the other side.
senses.exampleChinese: 双方理解拟议的改动为何对对方重要后，都愿意作出妥协。

senses.english: an agreement in which each side accepts less than it originally wanted
senses.exampleEnglish: The compromise allowed the club to offer evening sessions without cancelling the weekend activities that families already relied on.
senses.exampleChinese: 折中方案让俱乐部能开晚场，又不取消家庭已依赖的周末活动。

senses.english: to weaken or put something important at risk
senses.exampleEnglish: We should not compromise safety to finish the repairs sooner, even though the hall is needed for a busy weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使繁忙周末需要礼堂，也不能为提早完工而牺牲安全。

senses.english: to succeed in doing; complete successfully
senses.exampleEnglish: By sharing the research tasks, we managed to accomplish more in one afternoon than we had expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 通过分担研究任务，我们在一个下午完成的工作超过了预期。

senses.english: quality of not being powerful or strong
senses.exampleEnglish: Recognising a weakness in your study habits is useful if it helps you choose a more effective approach.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果认识到学习习惯的弱点能帮你选择更有效的方法，那就是有益的。

senses.chinese: 特别的喜好；难以抵抗的偏爱
senses.english: a strong liking for something that is difficult to resist
senses.exampleEnglish: She admits a weakness for old maps and rarely leaves a second-hand bookshop without looking carefully through its collection.
senses.exampleChinese: 她承认自己特别喜爱旧地图，逛旧书店几乎总会仔细翻看地图收藏。

senses.english: act of informing people about something publicly
senses.exampleEnglish: The announcement about the new timetable arrived too late for some passengers to change their travel plans.
senses.exampleChinese: 新时刻表的通知来得太晚，部分乘客已无法调整行程。

senses.english: (v) to use (n) a natural white substance used to flavor or preserve food
senses.exampleEnglish: Taste the soup before adding salt, because the vegetables may already provide enough flavour for your guests.
senses.exampleChinese: 加盐前先尝尝汤，因为蔬菜可能已为客人提供足够的味道。

senses.english: to add salt to food
senses.exampleEnglish: Salt the vegetables lightly before roasting them, because the sauce you add later already contains a fairly strong flavour.
senses.exampleChinese: 烤蔬菜前稍加盐，因为之后添加的酱汁味道已很浓。

phrases.english: used when advising someone not to believe something completely
phrases.exampleEnglish: Take the glowing review with a pinch of salt, because the writer received a free stay from the hotel being described.
phrases.exampleChinese: 对好评要有保留，因为作者获所评酒店免费住宿。

senses.english: (v) to (n) look at someone or something quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: I took a quick glance at the map before explaining which path would lead us back to the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 我迅速看了一眼地图，然后解释哪条路能带我们回到车站。

senses.english: to look at something quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: She glanced at the clock before starting another explanation, checking that the group still had enough time for questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 再作解释前她瞥了一眼钟，确认小组仍有足够时间提问。

phrases.english: when something is first seen or considered briefly
phrases.exampleEnglish: At first glance, the two maps look identical, but a closer check reveals that the path beside the river has changed.
phrases.exampleChinese: 乍看两图一样，细看却发现河边小路已变。

senses.english: play with music in which all the words are sung
senses.exampleEnglish: Although she had never seen an opera before, the story and music held her attention throughout the evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然她之前从未看过歌剧，故事和音乐却整晚吸引着她。

phrases.english: a continuing television or radio drama about people's personal lives
phrases.exampleEnglish: My grandmother follows a soap opera every evening and often discusses the characters' decisions with friends who watch the same programme.
phrases.exampleChinese: 祖母每晚看连续剧，常和同看节目的朋友讨论人物决定。

senses.english: an event in which people try to win
senses.exampleEnglish: The writing contest encouraged students to describe a familiar place from a viewpoint that readers might not expect.
senses.exampleChinese: 写作比赛鼓励学生从读者意想不到的视角描写熟悉的地方。

senses.english: to argue against a decision or compete to win a position
senses.exampleEnglish: Several members decided to contest the result because they believed the votes had not been counted according to the agreed rules.
senses.exampleChinese: 几名成员决定质疑结果，因为他们认为计票没有遵循约定规则。

senses.english: (v) to use (n) a thing to comb your hair or to clean the floor
senses.exampleEnglish: Use a soft brush to remove dirt from the shoes before applying the cleaning product recommended by the manufacturer.
senses.exampleChinese: 涂上厂家推荐的清洁剂前，用软刷清除鞋上的污垢。

senses.english: to clean, smooth, or arrange something using a brush
senses.exampleEnglish: Brush the mud from your shoes before entering the hall, so the volunteers do not have to clean the floor again.
senses.exampleChinese: 进大厅前刷掉鞋上的泥，免得志愿者再清理地板。

senses.english: to touch something lightly while moving past it
senses.exampleEnglish: The branches brushed my coat as I followed the narrow path, but I was too interested in the birds to mind.
senses.exampleChinese: 沿窄路走时树枝擦过外套，但我专注看鸟，并不介意。

senses.english: a short experience of something unpleasant or difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: Her first brush with failure taught her to ask for advice rather than give up as soon as progress became difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 第一次遭遇失败让她学会进展困难时征求建议，而不是马上放弃。

phrases.english: to improve knowledge or a skill that has not been used recently
phrases.exampleEnglish: I need to brush up on my English before the visit, especially the expressions used when asking for clarification during meetings.
phrases.exampleChinese: 访问前我需要重温英语，尤其会议中请求澄清的表达。

phrases.english: to refuse to consider something seriously
phrases.exampleEnglish: We should not brush aside a complaint simply because it sounds minor; it may reveal a problem affecting many other visitors.
phrases.exampleChinese: 不能因投诉听起来小就忽视，它可能揭示影响许多访客的问题。

phrases.english: to dismiss someone or their concern without proper attention
phrases.exampleEnglish: The assistant did not brush off our question, but took time to find someone who could explain the complicated instructions clearly.
phrases.exampleChinese: 工作人员没有敷衍问题，而是找人清楚解释复杂说明。

senses.english: to cause someone to feel uncomfortable about something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please do not embarrass him by mentioning the mistake in front of people who were not involved.
senses.exampleChinese: 请不要在与此事无关的人面前提起那个错误，让他难堪。

senses.english: place to look at various types of art
senses.exampleEnglish: The gallery invited visitors to compare paintings of the same street created by artists from different generations.
senses.exampleChinese: 画廊邀请访客比较不同年代画家描绘同一条街道的画作。

senses.english: a collection of images arranged for viewing, especially online
senses.exampleEnglish: The website's gallery shows photographs from earlier workshops, helping new visitors decide which activities might suit their own interests.
senses.exampleChinese: 网站图库展示往期工作坊照片，帮助新访客判断哪些活动适合自己的兴趣。

senses.english: a raised seating area in a theatre or public room
senses.exampleEnglish: We watched the play from the gallery, where the seats were cheaper but still offered a clear view of the stage.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在楼座看戏，座位虽便宜，却仍能清楚看到舞台。

senses.english: concerning the parts of a cell that determine particular characteristics
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum display explains how genetic information passes between generations, using simple diagrams rather than complicated technical language.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆的展板用简单图解而非复杂术语，说明遗传信息如何代代相传。

senses.english: behaving in a very threatening way
senses.exampleEnglish: The referee warned the player that aggressive behaviour would not be accepted, even during a highly competitive match.
senses.exampleChinese: 裁判警告那名球员，即使比赛竞争激烈，也不能容忍挑衅行为。

senses.english: strongly determined to succeed or gain an advantage
senses.exampleEnglish: The company adopted an aggressive advertising strategy, hoping to attract customers before its larger competitors launched similar products.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司采取强势广告策略，希望在大竞争对手推出类似产品前吸引顾客。

senses.english: the front of your body between your neck and your waist
senses.exampleEnglish: He held the heavy box close to his chest while carefully moving through the narrow entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 他把沉重的箱子贴近胸口，小心地穿过狭窄入口。

senses.english: a large strong box used for storing things
senses.exampleEnglish: The old wooden chest contained letters and photographs that helped the family understand why their grandparents had moved abroad.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧木箱里有信件和照片，帮助家人理解祖辈为何移居海外。

phrases.english: used about expressing a worry or feeling that has been troubling you
phrases.exampleEnglish: Getting a worry off your chest can help, especially when the listener asks questions instead of immediately deciding what you should do.
phrases.exampleChinese: 说出心事有帮助，尤其倾听者会提问而非立即替你决定。

senses.english: (v) to (n) form, design, or arrangement of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We changed the format of the report so that readers could find the main conclusions before reading the details.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们改变了报告格式，让读者能先找到主要结论，再阅读细节。

senses.english: to arrange the appearance or organisation of a document or other material
senses.exampleEnglish: Please format the report so that the headings are consistent and readers can quickly identify where each new section begins.
senses.exampleChinese: 请设置报告格式，统一标题，让读者快速看出各节从哪里开始。

senses.english: concerned with written works
senses.exampleEnglish: The festival includes literary discussions where readers can ask writers how personal experiences influence the stories they create.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个节日包括文学讨论，读者可以询问作家个人经历如何影响他们创作的故事。

senses.english: to officially control and lead an area
senses.exampleEnglish: The council must govern the town fairly while balancing the different needs of residents, businesses, and visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会必须公平治理城镇，同时平衡居民、企业和游客的不同需求。

senses.english: to control or strongly influence how something happens
senses.exampleEnglish: The available budget will govern which materials we choose, but we can still create an attractive display using simple supplies.
senses.exampleChinese: 可用预算决定材料选择，但我们仍能用简单用品做出好看展板。

senses.english: (v) to (n) hold someone closely
senses.exampleEnglish: She gave her brother a warm embrace when he returned after spending a full year studying abroad.
senses.exampleChinese: 哥哥在国外学习整整一年归来时，她热情地拥抱了他。

senses.english: to put your arms around someone to show affection
senses.exampleEnglish: She embraced her old friend at the station, delighted that they finally had time to meet after several busy years.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在车站拥抱老朋友，很高兴忙碌几年后终于有时间相聚。

senses.english: to accept an idea, opportunity, or change with enthusiasm
senses.exampleEnglish: The school decided to embrace the new approach after students reported that discussing mistakes helped them understand the subject better.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生反映讨论错误有助于理解后，学校决定欣然采用新方法。

senses.english: (v) to express (n) approval of something or someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach chose to praise their teamwork rather than focus only on the player who scored most often.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练选择表扬他们的团队合作，而不是只关注得分最多的球员。

senses.english: words that express approval or admiration
senses.exampleEnglish: The young team received praise for listening to one another, not just for reaching a conclusion before the other groups.
senses.exampleChinese: 年轻队伍因相互倾听而受表扬，而不只是因为比其他组早得出结论。

senses.english: not speaking or making noise
senses.exampleEnglish: The audience remained silent for a moment after the performance ended, before breaking into enthusiastic applause together.
senses.exampleChinese: 演出结束后，观众安静了片刻，然后一起爆发出热烈掌声。

senses.english: (v) to use (n) a device to move liquid or gas
senses.exampleEnglish: We had to pump water out of the cellar after heavy rain caused flooding along our street.
senses.exampleChinese: 大雨导致整条街积水后，我们不得不用泵把地窖里的水抽出去。

senses.english: a device that moves liquid or gas
senses.exampleEnglish: We kept a bicycle pump beside the entrance so visitors could check their tyres before setting off along the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在入口旁放了自行车打气筒，方便访客沿河出发前检查轮胎。

senses.english: to push air into something using a device
senses.exampleEnglish: He pumped air into the tyres before the ride, then checked that the brakes worked properly on the steep path.
senses.exampleChinese: 骑行前他给轮胎打气，再检查陡路上刹车能否正常工作。

senses.english: business that produces books or magazines
senses.exampleEnglish: The publisher asked for a shorter introduction so that young readers could reach the main story more quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 出版商要求缩短引言，让年轻读者更快进入主要故事。

senses.english: special event where people show the importance of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The village planned a celebration to thank the volunteers who had restored the playground during their free time.
senses.exampleChinese: 村庄计划举行庆典，感谢利用业余时间修复游乐场的志愿者。

senses.english: (v) to play (n) a game where you hit a ball into a hole with a stick
senses.exampleEnglish: He took up golf after retiring because the sport gave him a reason to spend more time outdoors.
senses.exampleChinese: 退休后他开始打高尔夫，因为这项运动让他能更多地待在户外。

senses.english: to play golf
senses.exampleEnglish: They golf together once a month, enjoying the chance to talk as much as the challenge of the course itself.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们每月一起打高尔夫，既享受球场挑战，也享受交谈机会。

senses.english: money given or received as payment for loss
senses.exampleEnglish: Passengers could request compensation when the cancellation forced them to pay for an extra night at a hotel.
senses.exampleChinese: 航班取消迫使乘客多付一晚酒店费用时，他们可以要求赔偿。

senses.english: concerning ideas considered to be traditional
senses.exampleEnglish: Although he usually listens to pop, he found that classical music helped him concentrate during long drawing sessions.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然他通常听流行音乐，他发现古典音乐能让他在长时间绘画时集中注意力。

senses.english: connected with the culture of ancient Greece or Rome
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum combines classical sculpture with modern explanations, helping visitors understand how the figures were originally displayed and used.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆结合古典雕塑与现代说明，帮助游客了解雕像原先如何展示和使用。

senses.english: to determine the weight of, using scales
senses.exampleEnglish: Please weigh each parcel before choosing a delivery option, since the final price depends partly on its weight.
senses.exampleChinese: 选择寄送方式前请称量每个包裹，因为最终价格部分取决于重量。

senses.english: to carefully compare possible choices, facts, or consequences
senses.exampleEnglish: We need to weigh the benefits against the costs before deciding whether the new equipment is worth buying for occasional use.
senses.exampleChinese: 决定是否值得为偶尔使用而购买新设备前，我们需要权衡收益和成本。

phrases.english: to cause someone continuing worry or unhappiness
phrases.exampleEnglish: The unfinished project began to weigh on her mind, so she asked the team to agree on one manageable next step.
phrases.exampleChinese: 未完项目使她担忧，于是请团队商定一个可做的下一步。

senses.english: used to show that a thing or person is against another thing or person
senses.exampleEnglish: The chart compares travelling by train versus flying, including the time spent reaching each departure point from home.
senses.exampleChinese: 图表比较坐火车与坐飞机，并计入从家到各出发地点的时间。

senses.english: an amount that is less than needed
senses.exampleEnglish: The club faced a budget deficit after ticket sales fell below the level needed to cover its expenses.
senses.exampleChinese: 门票销售未达到支付开支所需的水平后，俱乐部出现预算赤字。

senses.english: to make small changes to something
senses.exampleEnglish: We can modify the activity for smaller groups without changing the main skill that participants are meant to practise.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们可以为小组调整活动，而不改变参与者应该练习的主要技能。

senses.english: (v) to make (n) a sudden bright light
senses.exampleEnglish: A sudden flash of lightning revealed the distant hills before darkness covered the whole landscape once again.
senses.exampleChinese: 一道突如其来的闪电照亮了远山，随后整片景色又陷入黑暗。

senses.english: to shine brightly for a short time or at intervals
senses.exampleEnglish: The warning light began to flash while we were setting up the machine, so we checked the instructions before continuing.
senses.exampleChinese: 安装机器时警告灯开始闪烁，于是我们查说明后才继续。

senses.english: to show something very quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: She flashed her ticket at the entrance before joining the group that was already waiting beside the first exhibition room.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在入口迅速出示票，再加入已在第一展厅旁等候的小组。

senses.english: a camera light that produces a brief bright light
senses.exampleEnglish: Please turn off the flash before photographing the painting, because bright light can disturb visitors and affect delicate materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 拍画前请关闭闪光灯，因为强光会打扰参观者并影响脆弱材料。

phrases.english: very quickly or suddenly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The quiet courtyard filled in a flash when the doors opened, reminding us why the organisers had asked everyone to arrive early.
phrases.exampleChinese: 门开后院子转眼挤满人，说明组织者为何叫大家早到。

phrases.english: to suddenly remember an earlier event very clearly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The smell made me flash back to my grandmother's kitchen, where I used to help prepare lunch during school holidays.
phrases.exampleChinese: 气味让我骤然想起祖母厨房，小时候假期常在那帮做午饭。

senses.english: feeling of liking someone; good relationship
senses.exampleEnglish: Their friendship grew stronger when they learned to discuss disagreements honestly instead of pretending everything was always fine.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们学会坦诚讨论分歧，而不再假装一切都好，友谊因此更加牢固。

senses.english: job requiring special education or skills
senses.exampleEnglish: Teaching is a profession that requires patience, especially when different students need different explanations of the same idea.
senses.exampleChinese: 教学是一项需要耐心的职业，尤其是不同学生需要对同一概念作不同解释时。

senses.english: all the people who work in a particular skilled occupation
senses.exampleEnglish: The teaching profession has discussed the new approach widely, although individual schools differ in how quickly they want to introduce it.
senses.exampleChinese: 教育界广泛讨论新方法，但各校希望引入的速度不同。

senses.english: in a way that expresses the exact meaning of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The instruction should be read literally: leave the box open, rather than simply loosening the tape around it.
senses.exampleChinese: 这条说明应按字面理解：让盒子敞开，而不是只松开周围的胶带。

senses.english: used informally to emphasise a statement, sometimes without a strictly exact meaning
senses.exampleEnglish: I was literally jumping with excitement when the letter arrived, although my brother says I never left the chair.
senses.exampleChinese: 信到时我简直兴奋得跳起来，虽然弟弟说我根本没离开椅子。

senses.english: a statement showing things to be equal
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher drew a balance to explain why changing one side of an equation requires changing the other.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师画了一个天平，解释为何改变等式一边时也需要改变另一边。

senses.english: (v) to make (n) a hand or body movement that expresses a particular idea or feeling
senses.exampleEnglish: A friendly gesture from the guide helped the nervous child feel welcome before the group entered the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 进博物馆前，导游的友善举动让紧张的孩子感到受欢迎。

senses.english: to move your hands or body to express something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide gestured towards an empty bench, inviting the tired visitors to sit while she explained the next part of the tour.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游示意空长椅，请疲倦游客坐下，同时讲解下一段游览。

senses.english: to take care of guests by helping them enjoy their time
senses.exampleEnglish: We wanted to entertain our guests without making complicated plans, so we organised a relaxed evening of board games.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们想招待客人又不作复杂安排，于是组织了一个轻松的桌游之夜。

senses.english: to keep people interested or amused
