senses.exampleEnglish: The storyteller entertained the children with a funny account of her first day at school, turning nervous silence into laughter.
senses.exampleChinese: 讲故事的人用自己开学第一天的趣事逗孩子，把紧张沉默变成笑声。

senses.english: to consider or allow a particular idea or possibility
senses.exampleEnglish: We would entertain a different plan if it gave families more time together without increasing the cost of the event.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果另一计划不增加活动费用却让家庭多些相聚时间，我们愿意考虑。

senses.english: very fanciful in design, construction, or appearance
senses.exampleEnglish: The story describes a fantastic castle with moving staircases and windows that open onto different seasons of the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事描写了一座奇幻城堡，楼梯会移动，窗户通往一年中不同的季节。

senses.english: extremely good or enjoyable
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers did a fantastic job preparing the hall, creating a welcoming space from materials that had almost been thrown away.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者把礼堂布置得非常好，用差点被丢弃的材料创造了宜人空间。

senses.english: to give someone a particular job or something to do
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher will assign each group a different question so that the class can compare several possible explanations.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师将给各组布置不同的问题，让全班比较几种可能的解释。

senses.english: to give a particular place, value, or resource to someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: Each group was assigned a table near the window so that everyone had enough light to examine the small objects.
senses.exampleChinese: 每组被分到窗边一张桌子，让大家有足够光线观察小物件。

senses.english: continual rise in the prices of products
senses.exampleEnglish: Rising inflation meant that the same weekly shopping budget bought fewer groceries than it had the previous year.
senses.exampleChinese: 通胀上升意味着同样的每周购物预算买到的食品比上一年少。

senses.english: belonging to the past; of what is important or famous in the past
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents gathered to mark the historic opening of the bridge, which connected their town to the railway network.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民聚集起来纪念桥梁具有历史意义的通车，它使城镇接入铁路网。

senses.english: do physical harm or damage
senses.exampleEnglish: Trying to lift the cabinet without help could injure your back, so ask someone to assist you first.
senses.exampleChinese: 独自抬柜子可能伤到背部，因此先请人帮忙。

senses.english: far away
senses.exampleEnglish: The remote village welcomed a regular bus service, making it easier for residents to reach the nearest market.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个偏远村庄迎来了定期公交服务，居民去最近的市场更方便了。

senses.english: very unlikely to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: There is only a remote chance of finding the original drawing, but the museum will continue checking its records.
senses.exampleChinese: 找到原画机会很小，但博物馆仍会继续查记录。

senses.english: happening or controlled from a distance rather than in the same place
senses.exampleEnglish: Remote lessons allowed students in distant villages to join the course without travelling several hours to the college each week.
senses.exampleChinese: 远程课程让偏远村庄学生不用每周花几小时去学院也能参加。

senses.english: a device used to control equipment from a distance
senses.exampleEnglish: We could not find the remote, so someone had to use the buttons on the television to lower the sound.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们找不到遥控器，只好有人用电视上的按钮调低音量。

senses.english: treatment intended to help fix your problem or medical illness
senses.exampleEnglish: During therapy, he discussed the difficulties that had affected his confidence and practised ways to manage everyday situations.
senses.exampleChinese: 治疗期间，他讨论了影响信心的困难，并练习应对日常情境的方法。

senses.english: a color that is a mixture of red and yellow
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose an orange jacket for the cycling trip because it would be easy to see in dull weather.
senses.exampleChinese: 她为骑行选择了一件橙色外套，因为阴暗天气里容易被看见。

senses.english: a round fruit with orange skin and a juicy inside
senses.exampleEnglish: She packed an orange and a sandwich for the journey, choosing food that would be easy to carry and share.
senses.exampleChinese: 她给旅途装了橙子和三明治，选择便于携带和分享的食物。

senses.english: the colour between red and yellow
senses.exampleEnglish: The painter mixed orange with a little yellow to capture the warm light falling across the wall at sunset.
senses.exampleChinese: 画家把橙色混少许黄色，描绘落日照在墙上的暖光。

senses.english: (v) to make (n) turns in something, often in an opposite direction
senses.exampleEnglish: Twist the lid gently while holding the jar steady, rather than forcing it with a sudden movement.
senses.exampleChinese: 一边扶稳罐子，一边轻轻旋转盖子，不要猛地用力。

senses.english: a turn or bend in something
senses.exampleEnglish: A slight twist in the wire made the model lean sideways, so we carefully straightened it before adding the final pieces.
senses.exampleChinese: 金属丝轻微扭曲使模型倾斜，于是我们先拉直再添加最后零件。

senses.english: an unexpected change in a story or situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The final twist in the story made us reconsider the clues, which had seemed unimportant when we first read them.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事最后的转折让我们重新考虑初读时觉得不重要的线索。

senses.english: to change the meaning of words or facts in a misleading way
senses.exampleEnglish: The article twisted her comments to suggest she opposed the project, although she had only asked for more information.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章歪曲她的话，暗示她反对项目，虽然她只是要求更多信息。

phrases.english: to persuade me to do something I was not planning to do
phrases.exampleEnglish: You will not need to twist my arm to join the picnic, especially if everyone brings a favourite dish to share.
phrases.exampleChinese: 不用劝我也会野餐，尤其大家都带最爱食物分享的话。

senses.english: group of people who work for a company
senses.exampleEnglish: All personnel must attend the short briefing before entering the building, including those who normally work elsewhere.
senses.exampleChinese: 所有人员都必须在进入大楼前参加简短说明会，包括平时在别处工作的人。

senses.english: the ability to think of new ideas or things that are not real
senses.exampleEnglish: The activity encourages children to use their imagination by inventing a town where familiar problems have unusual solutions.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个活动鼓励孩子发挥想象力，虚构一个用奇妙方式解决常见问题的小镇。

senses.english: to have a different opinion from someone
senses.exampleEnglish: We may disagree about the best solution, but we can still listen carefully to each other's reasons.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们可能对最佳方案意见不同，但仍可以仔细听取彼此的理由。

senses.english: passage inside the neck used to swallow and breathe
senses.exampleEnglish: Her throat felt dry after speaking for an hour, so she paused to drink some water before continuing.
senses.exampleChinese: 说了一小时后，她感到喉咙干，于是停下来喝水再继续。

senses.english: the part of the neck used when speaking or swallowing
senses.exampleEnglish: He cleared his throat before beginning the announcement, waiting until the room became quiet enough for everyone to hear.
senses.exampleChinese: 他开始通知前清了清嗓子，等到房间安静到大家都能听见。

phrases.english: arguing or fighting angrily with one another
phrases.exampleEnglish: The characters spend most of the chapter at each other's throats, until a shared problem forces them to work together again.
phrases.exampleChinese: 人物一章大多激烈争吵，直到共同问题迫其再合作。

senses.english: a clear idea about how something works
senses.exampleEnglish: Talking to regular passengers gave the planners valuable insight into problems that the official timetable did not show.
senses.exampleChinese: 与常乘车的乘客交谈，让规划人员深入了解了官方时刻表未显示的问题。

senses.english: to take action to solve a difficult problem
senses.exampleEnglish: The school decided to tackle food waste by asking students which meals they enjoyed and adjusting portions accordingly.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校决定通过询问学生喜欢哪些餐食并相应调整分量，处理食物浪费问题。

senses.english: to try to stop an opposing player in a sport by challenging them for the ball
senses.exampleEnglish: She learned to tackle carefully during practice so that she could challenge for the ball without putting other players at risk.
senses.exampleChinese: 她练习时学会小心抢截，争球时不使其他球员受伤。

senses.english: an attempt to stop a player in a game by challenging for the ball
senses.exampleEnglish: The referee stopped play after a late tackle, giving the injured player time to leave the field before the match continued.
senses.exampleChinese: 一次迟到的抢截后裁判暂停比赛，让受伤球员先离场再继续。

senses.english: for a very long or seemingly endless time
senses.exampleEnglish: We knew the visit could not last forever, but leaving was harder after spending such a happy summer together.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们知道这次相聚不可能永远持续，但一起度过快乐的夏天后，分别更难了。

senses.english: to be greater in number than something
senses.exampleEnglish: The number of visitors must not exceed the hall's capacity, even if more people ask to join the event.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使有更多人要求参加，访客人数也不能超过大厅容量。

senses.english: amount of money used during a certain time
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee reviewed its annual expenditure to see whether more money could be directed towards improving children's activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会审查了年度支出，看能否将更多资金用于改善儿童活动。

senses.english: feeling of great happiness and pleasure
senses.exampleEnglish: Watching the seedlings grow brought her unexpected joy, especially after several earlier attempts at gardening had failed.
senses.exampleChinese: 看着幼苗生长给她带来意外的喜悦，尤其在此前几次园艺尝试失败之后。

senses.english: a person or thing that gives great pleasure
senses.exampleEnglish: Working with such a thoughtful group was a joy, because everyone listened carefully and helped when a problem appeared.
senses.exampleChinese: 与体贴的小组共事很愉快，大家认真倾听，遇到问题就帮忙。

phrases.english: to be extremely happy about something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The children wanted to jump for joy when they heard the garden would stay open, but waited until the announcement was finished.
phrases.exampleChinese: 听说花园会继续开放，孩子高兴极了，但等通知结束才庆祝。

senses.english: when a female carries a baby inside her that is not yet born
senses.exampleEnglish: When she became pregnant, she and her partner began discussing how they would share work and family responsibilities.
senses.exampleChinese: 怀孕后，她和伴侣开始讨论如何分担工作与家庭责任。

senses.english: deserving of your trust, dependable
senses.exampleEnglish: We need a reliable way to contact each other in case the group becomes separated during the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们需要可靠的联络方式，以防旅行中队伍走散。

senses.english: special supplies, tools, or clothes needed for a particular activity; machinery that turns power into forward or backward movement
senses.exampleEnglish: Before the walking trip, we checked our gear to make sure everyone had suitable shoes and waterproof clothing.
senses.exampleChinese: 徒步出发前，我们检查了装备，确保每个人都有合适的鞋和防水衣物。

senses.english: a part of a machine that changes how power is passed on
senses.exampleEnglish: Choose a lower gear before climbing the steep hill, so you can keep moving without pushing too hard on the pedals.
senses.exampleChinese: 爬陡坡前换低挡，让你不用猛踩踏板也能继续前进。

senses.english: to organise or design something for a particular need
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop is geared towards beginners, so the instructor explains unfamiliar terms before asking everyone to complete a practical task.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊面向初学者，因此教练先解释生词再让大家完成实作任务。

phrases.english: to prepare actively for something that will happen
phrases.exampleEnglish: We need to gear up for the busy weekend by checking supplies and making sure every volunteer knows where to report.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们须查物资并确保志愿者知道报到处，为忙周末备好。

senses.english: (v) to (n ) press a button
senses.exampleEnglish: Click the blue button after checking your answers, and a message will confirm that your work has been saved.
senses.exampleChinese: 检查答案后点击蓝色按钮，消息会确认你的作业已保存。

senses.english: a short sharp sound, or an act of pressing a button
senses.exampleEnglish: A click from the lock told us the door was secure, but we checked the handle before leaving the empty building.
senses.exampleChinese: 锁的咔嗒声表示门已锁好，但离开空楼前我们仍拉了拉门把。

senses.english: to suddenly become clear or understood
senses.exampleEnglish: The explanation finally clicked when the teacher drew a diagram that connected the new idea with something we already knew.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师画图把新概念与已知事物联系起来后，我们终于明白了解释。

senses.english: to quickly like and understand another person
senses.exampleEnglish: The two volunteers clicked immediately, discovering that they shared an interest in local history and the same relaxed way of working.
senses.exampleChinese: 两名志愿者立即合得来，发现彼此都喜爱地方历史，工作方式也同样轻松。

senses.english: person who writes poems
senses.exampleEnglish: The poet described an ordinary journey in such careful detail that readers noticed things they usually passed without thinking.
senses.exampleChinese: 诗人细致地描写一次普通旅程，让读者注意到平时未经思索便略过的事物。

senses.english: chance or luck, particularly good luck
senses.exampleEnglish: By good fortune, we found a shop still open just as the rain became too heavy to walk through.
senses.exampleChinese: 幸运的是，雨大得无法继续行走时，我们恰好找到一家还开着的商店。

senses.english: a very large amount of money
senses.exampleEnglish: Repairing the old roof would cost a fortune, so the owners looked for grants before deciding how to save the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 修旧屋顶要花大笔钱，于是业主先寻找补助，再决定如何保留建筑。

senses.english: what happens to a person or organisation, especially success or failure
senses.exampleEnglish: The town's fortunes changed when the railway reopened, bringing visitors and new opportunities for the small businesses near the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 铁路重开带来游客和新机会后，车站附近小商家的城镇境况改变了。

phrases.english: to claim to predict what will happen in people's lives
phrases.exampleEnglish: A character who can tell fortunes appears in the story, but the ending questions whether her predictions were ever reliable.
phrases.exampleChinese: 故事出现会算命的角色，但结局质疑预测是否可靠。

senses.english: special social or religious event
senses.exampleEnglish: The ceremony ended with students thanking the people who had supported them throughout their years at the school.
senses.exampleChinese: 典礼最后，学生向那些在整个求学期间支持他们的人表示感谢。

senses.english: (v) to make (n) a group of things one on top of another
senses.exampleEnglish: A pile of donated books stood beside the entrance while volunteers decided which shelves would suit them best.
senses.exampleChinese: 一堆捐赠图书摆在入口旁，志愿者正在决定放在哪些书架最合适。

senses.english: to put many things together in a heap
senses.exampleEnglish: Please do not pile the wet coats on the chairs, because they need space and fresh air to dry properly.
senses.exampleChinese: 请别把湿外套堆在椅子上，因为它们需要空间和通风才能干。

phrases.english: to increase or collect in a large amount
phrases.exampleEnglish: Small unfinished tasks can pile up quickly, so we set aside ten minutes at the end of each session to organise them.
phrases.exampleChinese: 小任务未完会迅速积累，因此每次结束留十分钟整理。

senses.english: farm animal that gives bacon and ham
senses.exampleEnglish: At the farm, we watched a pig search through the straw while the farmer explained its daily routine.
senses.exampleChinese: 在农场里，我们看一头猪在稻草里翻找，农场主讲解它的日常生活。

senses.english: an insulting word for someone who eats too much or behaves selfishly
senses.exampleEnglish: Calling someone a pig because of how much they eat can embarrass them and make a shared meal unpleasant.
senses.exampleChinese: 因为吃得多就骂人是猪，会让对方难堪并使聚餐不愉快。

phrases.english: to eat a lot, often more than necessary
phrases.exampleEnglish: They planned to pig out after the match, but eventually chose a simple shared meal because everyone was too tired to cook much.
phrases.exampleChinese: 他们本想赛后大吃，最后因太累不愿多煮而简单聚餐。

phrases.english: used humorously to say that something will never happen
phrases.exampleEnglish: He joked that he would enjoy washing dishes when pigs fly, although he still took his turn after the family meal.
phrases.exampleChinese: 他笑说除非猪会飞才喜欢洗碗，但饭后仍轮班洗。

senses.english: something made by combining two or more things
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop attracted a mixture of beginners and experienced artists, which led to useful exchanges of ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊吸引了初学者和经验丰富的艺术家混合参加，促成了有益的思想交流。

senses.english: in a way not requiring control by a person
senses.exampleEnglish: The document is saved automatically every few minutes, although keeping a separate copy is still a sensible precaution.
senses.exampleChinese: 文档每隔几分钟自动保存，但另存副本仍是明智的预防措施。

senses.english: a person who studies and knows a lot about a particular subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The scholar spent several years comparing old letters before publishing a book about everyday life in the region.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位学者花了几年比较旧信件，之后出版了一本关于该地区日常生活的书。

senses.english: having to do with the mind
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach discussed the psychological side of competition, including how players respond when their first plan fails.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练讨论了比赛的心理层面，包括球员在第一个计划失败时如何反应。

senses.english: in a sudden or extreme manner
senses.exampleEnglish: The number of visitors increased dramatically after the museum introduced free evening sessions for local families to attend.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆推出面向当地家庭的免费夜场后，参观人数显著增加。

senses.english: a strong stick with a pointed end that you push into the ground
senses.exampleEnglish: We tied the young tree to a wooden stake so that strong winds would not bend its trunk.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把小树绑在木桩上，防止强风吹弯树干。

senses.english: a share or interest in something, especially money or an outcome
senses.exampleEnglish: Local families have a stake in the library's future because they rely on its space for learning and community activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地家庭与图书馆未来利益相关，因为他们依靠这里学习和参加社区活动。

senses.english: to risk money or something valuable on an uncertain outcome
senses.exampleEnglish: She would not stake the club's savings on an untested plan, even though its supporters promised that it would succeed.
senses.exampleChinese: 她不愿把俱乐部积蓄押在未经检验的计划上，即使支持者保证成功。

senses.english: to support a plant with a post fixed in the ground
senses.exampleEnglish: We staked the young trees before the windy season, tying them loosely enough to allow some movement as their roots developed.
senses.exampleChinese: 风季前我们给小树设支桩，绑得较松，让根成长时仍能略动。

phrases.english: at risk of being lost or damaged
phrases.exampleEnglish: More than money is at stake in this decision, because the centre provides a place where isolated residents can build friendships.
phrases.exampleChinese: 决定关系的不止钱，中心让孤独居民有地方建立友谊。

senses.english: animal of any type
senses.exampleEnglish: The children drew an imaginary creature and then explained how it would find food in its unusual habitat.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们画了一个想象中的生物，再解释它如何在特殊栖息地寻找食物。

senses.english: an imaginary living being, often unusual or frightening
senses.exampleEnglish: The book's strange creature seemed frightening at first, but its actions eventually showed that it was trying to protect the forest.
senses.exampleChinese: 书里奇怪生物起初吓人，但行为后来显示它想保护森林。

phrases.english: things that make daily life comfortable
phrases.exampleEnglish: The cabin had few creature comforts, but its warm blankets and quiet setting made it a pleasant place to spend the night.
phrases.exampleChinese: 小屋舒适设施不多，但暖毯和安静环境让过夜愉快。

senses.english: working with others for some purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The partnership between the school and the museum gives students regular opportunities to learn outside the classroom.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校与博物馆的合作关系为学生提供了定期在课堂之外学习的机会。

senses.english: act of being involved in something
senses.exampleEnglish: Active participation in the discussion matters more than giving a perfect answer, especially when we are exploring unfamiliar ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 积极参与讨论比给出完美答案更重要，尤其是在探索陌生概念时。

senses.english: a separate part of a contract, a will, or another legal document
senses.exampleEnglish: Before signing, she asked the organiser to explain a clause about what would happen if the event was cancelled.
senses.exampleChinese: 签字前，她请组织者解释有关活动取消后如何处理的条款。

senses.english: punishment for committing a crime or offense
senses.exampleEnglish: The notice explained the penalty for returning equipment late, so members could plan their bookings more carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 通知解释了逾期归还设备的处罚，使会员能更仔细安排预订。

senses.english: a room or space inside something used for a special purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: Visitors entered a small chamber beneath the castle, where food had once been stored during the winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 游客进入城堡下方一个小室，那里过去在冬季储存食物。

senses.english: not plain or ordinary, expensive
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not need a fancy restaurant to celebrate; sharing a simple meal with friends felt equally special.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不需要豪华餐厅来庆祝，与朋友共享简单餐食同样特别。

senses.english: to want or feel like having or doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: Do you fancy joining us for a short walk after lunch, if the rain stops before we leave the house?
senses.exampleChinese: 如果出门前雨停了，午饭后你想加入我们短途散步吗？

senses.english: to imagine or believe something, sometimes without good reason
senses.exampleEnglish: He fancied himself an expert after reading one article, until the class discussion revealed how much more there was to learn.
senses.exampleChinese: 读一篇文章后他就自认专家，直到课堂讨论揭示还有许多可学。

phrases.english: to begin to like or want something
phrases.exampleEnglish: If you take a fancy to one of the paintings, ask the artist about it before deciding whether to buy a print.
phrases.exampleChinese: 喜欢上哪幅画，可先问画家再决定是否买复制品。

phrases.english: clothes worn to look like a character or another kind of person
phrases.exampleEnglish: The children prepared fancy dress for the celebration, using old fabric rather than asking their families to buy expensive costumes.
phrases.exampleChinese: 孩子用旧布准备庆典化装服，而非让家人买贵服装。

senses.english: poetic writing; imaginative verses
senses.exampleEnglish: Reading poetry aloud helped the class notice how sound and rhythm could change the feeling of ordinary words.
senses.exampleChinese: 朗读诗歌帮助全班注意到，声音和节奏如何改变普通词语传达的感觉。

senses.english: (v) to (n) talk in a friendly and relaxed manner
senses.exampleEnglish: We stayed for a short chat after the meeting, which gave us time to clear up a misunderstanding.
senses.exampleChinese: 会议后我们留下来简短聊了聊，有时间澄清一个误会。

senses.english: to talk in a relaxed and friendly way
senses.exampleEnglish: We chatted while putting away the chairs, enjoying a chance to hear how everyone's week had gone outside the project.
senses.exampleChinese: 收椅子时我们闲聊，愉快地听彼此项目之外的一周生活。

senses.english: things you wear on your body
senses.exampleEnglish: Pack clothing that you can wear in layers, since the temperature may change considerably during the mountain walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 带上可以分层穿的衣服，因为山区徒步期间气温可能变化很大。

senses.english: to slowly change or develop into something better
senses.exampleEnglish: A good plan can evolve as new information becomes available, rather than remaining fixed from the first day.
senses.exampleChinese: 好的计划会随着新信息出现而逐步发展，而不是从第一天起就固定不变。

senses.english: interest or benefit of someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: For the sake of fairness, each group was given the same materials and exactly the same preparation time.
senses.exampleChinese: 为了公平起见，每组获得相同的材料和完全相同的准备时间。

phrases.english: in order to help, protect, or achieve something
phrases.exampleEnglish: For the sake of fairness, we gave every group the same preparation time before asking them to present their ideas to the class.
phrases.exampleChinese: 为公平起见，各组展示前都获同样准备时间。

senses.english: flat board attached to a wall on which to store things
senses.exampleEnglish: She cleared a shelf near the window so that the plants would receive enough light throughout the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 她清空了窗边的一层架子，让植物全天能获得足够光照。

senses.english: (v) to cause (n) an increase in progress, growth, or success
senses.exampleEnglish: A few encouraging comments can boost someone's confidence, especially when they are trying something difficult for the first time.
senses.exampleChinese: 几句鼓励的话能增强信心，尤其是在第一次尝试困难的事情时。

senses.english: something that increases confidence, strength, or success
senses.exampleEnglish: The positive review gave the small café a boost, attracting customers who had previously walked past without noticing it.
senses.exampleChinese: 好评推动小咖啡馆生意，吸引了以前路过却没注意它的顾客。

senses.english: back end of an animal's body that sticks out
senses.exampleEnglish: The dog's tail moved excitedly when it heard the familiar sound of its owner's bicycle outside the gate.
senses.exampleChinese: 狗听到门外主人自行车熟悉的声音时，兴奋地摇起尾巴。

senses.english: to follow someone closely, often without being noticed
senses.exampleEnglish: In the detective story, a stranger tails the main character through the city, forcing her to change her usual route.
senses.exampleChinese: 侦探故事中，陌生人一路跟踪主人公，迫使她改变平时路线。

phrases.english: to become quieter or smaller gradually
phrases.exampleEnglish: The applause began to tail off as the speaker returned, giving her space to thank the volunteers who had organised the evening.
phrases.exampleChinese: 发言者回来时掌声渐弱，她得以感谢组织晚会的志愿者。

senses.english: having or owning something
senses.exampleEnglish: The old diary remained in her possession for many years before she decided to donate it to the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 这本旧日记由她保存多年，之后她才决定捐给博物馆。

senses.english: something that a person owns
senses.exampleEnglish: She packed her most important possessions into one small bag before moving to the room she had rented near the college.
senses.exampleChinese: 搬进学院附近租的房间前，她把最重要的财物装进一个小包。

senses.english: a medical operation to end the time when a female is going to have a baby
senses.exampleEnglish: The documentary discusses how access to abortion differs across countries, while presenting the subject through carefully explained personal stories.
senses.exampleChinese: 纪录片通过仔细讲述的个人故事，讨论各国获得人工流产服务的差异。

collocations.chinese: 获得人工流产服务的途径

senses.english: wanting to know more about something
senses.exampleEnglish: The students were curious about how the machine worked, so the engineer opened a panel and explained its parts.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生很好奇机器如何运作，于是工程师打开面板解释各部件。

senses.english: strange or unusual in an interesting way
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a curious pattern on the stone, which none of us could explain until the guide pointed out the tool marks.
senses.exampleChinese: 石头上有奇怪图案，直到导游指出工具痕迹前我们都无法解释。

senses.english: made of wood
senses.exampleEnglish: The wooden bridge looked old, but a sign confirmed that it had recently been repaired and checked.
senses.exampleChinese: 木桥看起来很旧，但标牌确认它最近已修复并检查过。

senses.english: (v) to make (n) a loud deep  sound;  (v) to have (n) a period of rapid economic growth
senses.exampleEnglish: The town experienced a tourism boom after a popular film showed its dramatic coastline to audiences around the world.
senses.exampleChinese: 一部热门电影向全球观众展示壮丽海岸后，这个城镇经历了旅游业繁荣。

senses.english: a loud deep sound
senses.exampleEnglish: A distant boom interrupted the conversation, and the guide explained that work was continuing at the quarry beyond the hills.
senses.exampleChinese: 远处轰鸣打断谈话，导游解释山后采石场仍在作业。

senses.english: to make a loud deep sound
senses.exampleEnglish: The clock boomed across the square as the market opened, reminding the traders that another busy morning was beginning.
senses.exampleChinese: 市场开张时钟声响彻广场，提醒商贩又一个忙碌早晨开始了。

senses.english: to grow rapidly in business or popularity
senses.exampleEnglish: Tourism began to boom after the new train service made the coastal town easier to reach for weekend visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 新火车服务方便周末游客到海滨小镇后，旅游业开始蓬勃发展。

senses.english: story about colorful and imaginary events
senses.exampleEnglish: The old sailor told a tale about a mysterious island, keeping the children curious until the final sentence.
senses.exampleChinese: 老水手讲了一个神秘岛屿的故事，孩子们直到最后一句仍充满好奇。

senses.english: of democracy; entitling the people to power
senses.exampleEnglish: A democratic process gives members a voice in decisions, even when they do not all share the same opinion.
senses.exampleChinese: 民主程序让成员在决策中有发言权，即使大家的意见并不完全相同。

senses.english: keeping (a machine) working by checking and fixing it
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular maintenance kept the old bicycles in good condition, allowing the club to lend them to new members.
senses.exampleChinese: 定期维护使旧自行车保持良好状态，让俱乐部能借给新会员使用。

senses.english: therefore; as a result of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The footpath was flooded after the storm; consequently, the guide chose a longer route along the hillside.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴风雨后小路被水淹没，因此导游选择了沿山坡的一条较长路线。

senses.english: deep, round container that is used for cooking
senses.exampleEnglish: She covered the pot while the vegetables cooked, then lowered the heat to keep the soup from boiling over.
senses.exampleChinese: 煮蔬菜时她盖上锅盖，然后调小火，避免汤溢出来。

senses.english: to put a plant into a container with soil
senses.exampleEnglish: We potted the young plants in separate containers so that each would have enough space to grow before being moved outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把幼苗分别栽入容器，让每株移到室外前有足够空间生长。

senses.english: a shared amount of money available for a particular purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The prize pot grew throughout the afternoon as visitors bought tickets to support repairs to the village playground.
senses.exampleChinese: 访客买票支持村里游乐场维修，奖金池整个下午不断增加。

phrases.english: to accept whatever is available without knowing beforehand what it will be
phrases.exampleEnglish: We decided to take pot luck at the small café, ordering the daily dish without asking exactly which vegetables it contained.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们在小咖啡馆碰运气点每日菜，没问具体有哪些蔬菜。

senses.english: large farm animal from which we get milk and beef
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer explained how each cow was cared for while the children watched the morning feeding routine.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们看早晨喂食时，农场主解释每头奶牛如何受到照顾。

phrases.chinese: 稳定赚钱的业务；摇钱树
phrases.english: a business or product that regularly brings in a lot of money
phrases.exampleEnglish: The popular course became a cash cow for the centre, helping to pay for free activities that attracted fewer paying visitors.
phrases.exampleChinese: 热门课程成中心摇钱树，帮助支付付费访客较少的免费活动。

senses.english: to make something stronger
senses.exampleEnglish: Working together on the garden helped strengthen relationships between neighbours who had rarely spoken to one another before.
senses.exampleChinese: 一起打理花园，帮助平时很少交谈的邻居增进了关系。

senses.english: during the time that; at the same time
senses.exampleEnglish: Marta checked the route whilst her brother packed the food they would need for the long walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 玛尔塔检查路线时，她弟弟在打包长途步行需要的食物。

senses.english: something that limits or prevents someone or something from moving
senses.exampleEnglish: A limited budget was the main constraint, so the team reused materials instead of buying everything new.
senses.exampleChinese: 预算有限是主要限制，因此团队重复利用材料，而非全都购买新的。

senses.english: (v) to make (n) a bend in something flat by moving one part over another part
senses.exampleEnglish: Fold the map along its original lines so that it fits neatly back into the pocket of your bag.
senses.exampleChinese: 沿原来的折痕折叠地图，让它整齐地放回包里的口袋。

senses.english: a bend or overlapping part made in a flat material
senses.exampleEnglish: The old map had torn along one fold, so we placed it flat on the table before studying the route.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧地图沿一条折痕破了，我们先在桌上铺平再研究路线。

senses.english: to close because a business or organisation can no longer continue
senses.exampleEnglish: The small magazine folded after printing costs rose, but its editors continued sharing local stories through a free community website.
senses.exampleChinese: 印刷费用上升后小杂志停刊，但编辑继续用免费社区网站分享地方故事。

senses.english: a container for storing things
senses.exampleEnglish: Please put the clean paper in the recycling bin rather than mixing it with the food waste.
senses.exampleChinese: 请把干净纸张放入回收箱，而不要与厨余垃圾混在一起。

senses.english: to throw something away
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not bin the damaged folders yet, because we may be able to reuse their covers for the art workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 先别扔坏文件夹，我们可能还能用封皮做美术工作坊材料。

senses.english: to experience something, often bad
senses.exampleEnglish: The old theatre will undergo major repairs before it can safely welcome audiences for performances again next spring.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧剧院将进行大修，之后才能在明年春天再次安全接待观众观看演出。

senses.english: that could happen or become reality
senses.exampleEnglish: The missing page could potentially change our understanding of the story, so we searched the entire collection again.
senses.exampleChinese: 缺失的那页可能改变我们对故事的理解，因此我们又查找了整个文集。

senses.english: range of things that something includes
senses.exampleEnglish: We narrowed the scope of the project so that students could explore one question in greater depth.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们缩小了项目范围，让学生能更深入地探究一个问题。

senses.english: the opportunity or freedom to do or develop something
senses.exampleEnglish: The first draft leaves plenty of scope for improvement, especially in the way it connects the examples to the main argument.
senses.exampleChinese: 初稿有很大改进空间，尤其是例子与主要论证的衔接方式。

senses.english: to act as if something is true when it is not
senses.exampleEnglish: The children decided to pretend they were explorers, turning the garden into a landscape full of imaginary challenges.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们决定假装自己是探险家，把花园变成充满想象中的挑战的地貌。

senses.english: state or quality of having a range of different things
senses.exampleEnglish: The school celebrates the diversity of its community by inviting families to share their different languages and traditions.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校邀请各家庭分享不同语言和传统，以庆祝社区的多样性。

senses.english: to state without proof
senses.exampleEnglish: Several passengers allege that the service was cancelled without warning, although the company says it sent a notice.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位乘客声称服务取消前没有通知，但公司表示已发出通知。

senses.english: when you respect yourself
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt a quiet sense of pride when her class used the reading corner she had designed herself.
senses.exampleChinese: 看到同学们使用自己设计的阅读角，她内心感到自豪。

senses.english: to feel proud of a particular ability or quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The café prides itself on welcoming every visitor warmly, even when the staff are busy preparing orders for a large group.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆以热情欢迎每位访客为傲，即使员工正忙于给大团体备餐。

phrases.english: someone or something that gives a person great pleasure and pride
phrases.exampleEnglish: The restored garden was her pride and joy, especially when children used the reading corner she had designed with local volunteers.
phrases.exampleChinese: 修复花园是她珍宝，尤其孩子使用她与志愿者设计的阅读角时。

senses.english: very strong, great, or extreme in degree
senses.exampleEnglish: After a week of intense discussion, the group finally agreed on a plan that addressed everyone's main concerns.
senses.exampleChinese: 经过一周激烈讨论，小组终于就一个回应所有人主要顾虑的计划达成一致。

senses.english: request for information
senses.exampleEnglish: I sent an inquiry about the course because the website did not clearly explain which materials were included.
senses.exampleChinese: 我发信咨询了课程，因为网站没清楚说明包含哪些材料。

senses.english: an official process of examining a problem to discover the facts
senses.exampleEnglish: The school began an inquiry after parents raised concerns, promising to listen carefully before deciding what changes were needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 家长提出顾虑后，学校展开调查，承诺仔细听取意见再决定需哪些改动。

senses.english: to leave a job because you want to
senses.exampleEnglish: She decided to resign from the committee after realising she could no longer give the role enough time.
senses.exampleChinese: 意识到无法再给这个职位投入足够时间后，她决定退出委员会。

senses.english: to accept something unpleasant because you believe you cannot change it
senses.exampleEnglish: We refused to resign ourselves to losing the garden and instead asked neighbours to help us suggest another plan.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不愿听任花园被毁，而是请邻居帮助提出另一方案。

senses.english: (n) an activity or object where people (v) make something by hand and with much skill
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop introduces a traditional craft in which simple tools are used to turn wood into useful household objects.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊介绍一种传统手艺，用简单工具把木材制成实用的家居用品。

senses.english: to make something carefully and with skill
senses.exampleEnglish: The students crafted a short speech together, choosing examples that would explain the problem clearly without blaming any individual.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生一起精心写了短讲，选例子清楚解释问题又不责怪个人。

senses.english: a boat, aircraft, or similar vehicle
senses.exampleEnglish: The small craft stayed close to the shore while the crew checked whether the wind was becoming too strong.
senses.exampleChinese: 船员检查风是否太大时，小船始终靠近岸边。

senses.english: must be obeyed
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum has strict rules about food because even small crumbs can attract insects that damage valuable objects.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆对食物有严格规定，因为小碎屑也可能引来损坏珍贵展品的昆虫。

senses.english: following an exact meaning or standard without exceptions
senses.exampleEnglish: In the strict sense of the rule, every entry must arrive before noon, even if the final page is missing.
senses.exampleChinese: 严格按规则，每份参赛作品都须午前送达，即使缺最后一页。

senses.english: hard substance used in building made by mixing cement, sand, small stones, and water
senses.exampleEnglish: The builders checked that the concrete was fully dry before allowing anyone to walk across the new path.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人确认混凝土完全干燥后，才允许人走过新铺的小路。

senses.english: definite and specific rather than general or abstract
senses.exampleEnglish: The class needed a concrete example before they could understand how the general principle applied to an ordinary shopping decision.
senses.exampleChinese: 全班需要具体例子才能理解一般原则如何用于普通购物决定。

senses.english: hard outer covering that protects
senses.exampleEnglish: The empty shell was so delicate that she placed it in a small box before carrying it home.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个空贝壳十分脆弱，她先把它放进小盒子，再带回家。

senses.english: to remove the hard outer covering of food
senses.exampleEnglish: We shelled the peas together while the soup cooked, turning preparation into a chance to talk about everyone's day.
senses.exampleChinese: 煮汤时我们一起剥豌豆，把备菜变成聊各自一天的机会。

senses.english: the outer structure of something when the inside is empty or missing
senses.exampleEnglish: Only the shell of the old factory remained, but the architect believed it could become a bright community workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧工厂只剩外壳，但建筑师认为它能成为明亮的社区工作坊。

phrases.english: to become more confident and willing to talk to others
phrases.exampleEnglish: Joining a small group can help you come out of your shell, particularly when everyone has time to explain their ideas without interruption.
phrases.exampleChinese: 加入小组有助不再害羞，尤其人人有时间不受打断地解释时。

phrases.english: to pay money, often unwillingly
phrases.exampleEnglish: We did not want to shell out for new furniture until we knew whether the donated tables could be repaired safely.
phrases.exampleChinese: 确认捐赠桌可否安全修好前，我们不想花钱买新家具。

senses.english: to say someone should be punished for their bad behavior
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker refused to damn an entire generation for mistakes that only a few individuals had made.
senses.exampleChinese: 发言者拒绝因少数个人犯下的错误而谴责整整一代人。

senses.english: a rude exclamation expressing anger or disappointment
senses.exampleEnglish: Damn, I left the tickets on the kitchen table, so we will have to return home before catching the train.
senses.exampleChinese: 糟了，我把票放在厨房桌上了，所以赶火车前得先回家。

senses.english: used rudely to emphasise annoyance about someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: The damn printer stopped again just as we were preparing the final copies, leaving everyone frustrated before the meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 那个该死的打印机在准备最后几份时又停了，让大家会前很烦。

senses.english: used rudely to strengthen an adjective or adverb
senses.exampleEnglish: He said the climb was damn difficult, but he was pleased that everyone had reached the viewpoint safely together.
senses.exampleChinese: 他说爬山真难，但很高兴大家一起安全到达观景点。

phrases.english: to not care at all
phrases.exampleEnglish: The character claims to not give a damn about winning, but his disappointment at the final result shows a different feeling.
phrases.exampleChinese: 角色声称毫不在乎输赢，但对结果的失望显示另一感受。

senses.english: clearly different in nature from something else
senses.exampleEnglish: The article presents two distinct explanations, and readers must compare the evidence before deciding which is more convincing.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章提出两种不同解释，读者必须比较证据，才能判断哪种更有说服力。

senses.english: easy to notice, recognise, or sense
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a distinct smell of fresh paint in the hallway, so we opened the windows before the visitors arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 走廊里明显有新油漆味，我们在访客到来前开了窗。

senses.english: quality of being funny
senses.exampleEnglish: A little humor helped the nervous group relax, but the speaker made sure nobody became the target of a joke.
senses.exampleChinese: 一点幽默让紧张的小组放松，但发言者确保无人沦为笑话对象。

senses.english: to agree with someone or do what they want to keep them pleased
senses.exampleEnglish: We humored our young guide by following her imaginary map, enjoying the detailed story she had invented for the garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们顺着小导游，照她想象的地图走，享受她为花园编的详细故事。

senses.english: act of controlling or reducing the size of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The main limitation of the survey was its small sample, so we avoided making claims about everyone.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项调查的主要局限是样本小，因此我们避免对所有人作出断言。

senses.english: a rule or condition that controls what is allowed or possible
senses.exampleEnglish: There is a limitation on how many visitors can enter at once, because the old staircase is narrow and difficult to pass.
senses.exampleChinese: 每次入内人数有限，因为旧楼梯狭窄，通行困难。

senses.english: something that signals that something else exists or will happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The long queue outside was an indication that the new exhibition had attracted more interest than expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 门外长长的队伍表明，新展览吸引的关注超过预期。

senses.english: quality of not being easily moved or changed
senses.exampleEnglish: The extra support improved the table's stability, making it safe to use on the uneven garden floor.
senses.exampleChinese: 额外支撑提高了桌子的稳定性，使它能安全放在花园不平整的地面上使用。

senses.english: knowledgeable about life; having good judgment
senses.exampleEnglish: It would be wise to check the last train time before deciding how late to stay at the festival.
senses.exampleChinese: 决定在节日活动待到多晚之前，先查末班车时间会很明智。

phrases.english: to become aware of the truth about something
phrases.exampleEnglish: The team began to wise up when the same problem returned, realising that a quick repair had not addressed its underlying cause.
phrases.exampleChinese: 同一问题重现，团队才醒悟临时修理没有解决根因。

senses.english: (v) to (n) not take care of something
senses.exampleEnglish: If we neglect the garden during the hottest weeks, the young plants may struggle to survive without regular watering.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果在最炎热的几周疏于照顾花园，幼苗可能难以在缺少定期浇水时存活。

senses.english: the failure to give someone or something proper care or attention
senses.exampleEnglish: Years of neglect had damaged the garden, but volunteers could still see how its paths and flower beds might be restored.
senses.exampleChinese: 多年失修损坏花园，但志愿者仍看得出如何恢复小路和花坛。

senses.english: to fail to do something that should be done
senses.exampleEnglish: She neglected to mention the change of address, so the invitation arrived at the house where she had lived previously.
senses.exampleChinese: 她忘了提地址变更，所以邀请函寄到了原来的房子。

senses.english: to come together to form or make something
senses.exampleEnglish: The surface of the path is composed of several materials, which give each section a different colour and texture.
senses.exampleChinese: 小路表面由几种材料构成，使每段具有不同的颜色和质感。

senses.english: to create music or a piece of writing
senses.exampleEnglish: The students composed a short song for the celebration, combining words from their own experiences with a simple melody everyone could learn.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生为庆祝活动创作短歌，把自身经历写进歌词，配上人人能学的简单旋律。

phrases.english: to regain control of your feelings and behaviour
phrases.exampleEnglish: Take a minute to compose yourself before the presentation, then begin with the example you have practised and understand most clearly.
phrases.exampleChinese: 展示前花一分钟镇静，再从练过且最清楚的例子开始。

senses.english: (v) to put someone in (n) a place to hold criminals being punished for a crime
senses.exampleEnglish: The documentary follows a teacher who organises reading groups in a jail to help prisoners continue their education.
senses.exampleChinese: 纪录片跟拍一位在监狱组织阅读小组、帮助囚犯继续受教育的老师。

senses.english: to put someone in prison
senses.exampleEnglish: The article explains why the court decided to jail the offender, rather than merely ordering a fine for the repeated offence.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章解释法院为何决定监禁屡次违法者，而不只是罚款。

senses.english: a place to live or stay that protects someone from weather
senses.exampleEnglish: When the rain became heavier, we found shelter beneath a large roof at the entrance to the station.
senses.exampleChinese: 雨势变大时，我们在车站入口的大屋檐下找到了避雨处。

senses.english: to protect someone or something from weather or danger
senses.exampleEnglish: The tall wall sheltered the young plants from strong winds, allowing them to grow before they were moved into the open garden.
senses.exampleChinese: 高墙保护幼苗免受强风，让它们长大后再移入开阔花园。

senses.english: small and unimportant
senses.exampleEnglish: What seemed a mere detail at first later proved essential to understanding why the experiment had failed.
senses.exampleChinese: 起初看似只是细节的东西，后来被证明对理解实验为何失败至关重要。

senses.english: a chemical element (C) found in all living things
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained how carbon moves through living systems, using a tree and the surrounding soil as examples.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师以树和周围土壤为例，解释碳如何在生命系统中循环。

phrases.english: the amount of greenhouse gas emissions associated with an activity or person
phrases.exampleEnglish: The class compared the carbon footprint of different journeys, while also discussing cost and whether the routes were practical for local families.
phrases.exampleChinese: 全班比较不同出行碳足迹，也讨论成本和路线对家庭是否实际。

senses.english: to make rules or laws to control something or someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The council introduced new rules to regulate traffic near the school, where families had reported several dangerous crossings.
senses.exampleChinese: 议会出台新规定管理学校附近交通，那里的家庭曾反映几处危险过街地点。

senses.english: a yellow or white food made from milk
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought some local cheese at the market and asked the seller which bread would go well with it.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在市场买了些当地奶酪，并问卖家搭配哪种面包合适。

senses.english: (v) to (n) cause something start happening
senses.exampleEnglish: An unexpected question can trigger a useful discussion, especially when it challenges an assumption that everyone has accepted.
senses.exampleChinese: 意外的问题能引发有益讨论，尤其是它质疑了大家都接受的假设时。

senses.english: a part of a device that is pressed to make it operate
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained how pressing the trigger started the spray, then asked everyone to point the tool away from other people.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释按下扳机会喷射，然后让大家把工具避开别人。

senses.english: something that causes a particular event or reaction to begin
senses.exampleEnglish: The cancelled meeting was the trigger for a wider discussion about why volunteers were finding it difficult to plan their time.
senses.exampleChinese: 会议取消引发了更广泛讨论，探讨志愿者为何难安排时间。

senses.english: tube a round, hollow piece of metal, plastic, or wood
senses.exampleEnglish: A damaged pipe caused water to leak into the kitchen, so we moved the furniture before calling for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 受损管道导致厨房漏水，于是我们先移开家具，再打电话求助。

senses.english: a small device with a bowl and tube used for smoking tobacco
senses.exampleEnglish: The old photograph shows a man holding a pipe, which helped the historian estimate when the picture might have been taken.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧照片中男子握着烟斗，这帮助历史学家估计拍摄年代。

senses.english: to carry water, gas, or another substance through tubes
senses.exampleEnglish: Water is piped from the storage tank to the garden, where volunteers can reach several taps without carrying heavy buckets.
senses.exampleChinese: 水从储水箱通过管道送到花园，志愿者可用几个水龙头，不必提重桶。

phrases.english: to stop making noise or speaking loudly
phrases.exampleEnglish: The organiser asked everyone to pipe down for a moment so the children could explain the display they had prepared together.
phrases.exampleChinese: 组织者请大家安静片刻，让孩子解释合做展板。

phrases.english: to start speaking, especially after being quiet
phrases.exampleEnglish: Do not be afraid to pipe up if you notice a mistake, because the group may have overlooked something important.
phrases.exampleChinese: 发现错误不要怕开口，小组可能漏掉重要事项。

senses.english: damaging something so badly that it no longer exists
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition shows how careful planning helped prevent the destruction of historic houses during the town's rapid expansion.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览展示了城镇迅速扩张期间，周密规划如何帮助避免历史房屋被毁。

senses.english: stringed musical instrument played with the fingers
senses.exampleEnglish: She borrowed a guitar from the school so that she could practise between lessons without buying an instrument immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 她从学校借了一把吉他，以便课间练习而不必马上购买乐器。

senses.english: piece of cloth, frequently marked with a colorful symbol or sign
senses.exampleEnglish: The children designed a flag for their imaginary island, choosing colours that represented its mountains, rivers, and forests.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们为想象中的岛设计旗帜，选择代表山脉、河流和森林的颜色。

senses.english: keyboard instrument used for playing music
senses.exampleEnglish: The old piano needed tuning before the concert, although its clear sound still filled the small village hall.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧钢琴演出前需要调音，但清亮的琴声仍能充满小小的村民礼堂。

senses.english: a special power that allows impossible things to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: In the story, the forest's magic fades whenever people stop caring for the trees and animals around them.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事里，只要人们不再照顾周围的树木和动物，森林的魔法就会减弱。

senses.english: a special quality that makes something unusually enjoyable or effective
senses.exampleEnglish: The magic of the evening came from the simple pleasure of hearing neighbours share stories that nobody had recorded before.
senses.exampleChinese: 那个夜晚的魅力来自听邻居分享无人记录过的故事这种简单乐趣。

senses.english: having or using powers that seem impossible in ordinary life
senses.exampleEnglish: The story's magic door opens only when the children work together, encouraging them to listen before trying to solve each puzzle.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事里的魔法门只有孩子合作才开，鼓励他们解谜前先倾听。

phrases.chinese: 仿佛魔法般；出乎意料地
phrases.english: in a surprising way that seems impossible to explain
phrases.exampleEnglish: The missing chairs appeared as if by magic just before the event, although later we learned a neighbour had delivered them quietly.
phrases.exampleChinese: 活动前失踪椅子如魔法出现，后来才知邻居悄悄送来。

senses.english: book, play, or film that deals with a solution of a strange crime
senses.exampleEnglish: She chose a mystery for the long journey because she enjoyed working out the answer before the final chapter.
senses.exampleChinese: 她为长途旅行选了一本推理小说，因为她喜欢在最后一章前找出答案。

senses.english: something that is not understood or has no known explanation
senses.exampleEnglish: How the key reached the garden remained a mystery until the child remembered carrying it while feeding the birds that morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 钥匙为何到花园一直是谜，直到孩子记起早晨喂鸟时带着它。

senses.english: (v) to move easily over snow on (n) one of a pair of long flat boards attached to the feet
senses.exampleEnglish: We learned to ski on a gentle slope before attempting the longer route that curved through the trees.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们先在缓坡学滑雪，才尝试穿过树林、弯弯曲曲的较长雪道。

senses.english: one of a pair of long narrow boards attached to boots for moving over snow
senses.exampleEnglish: One ski came loose during practice, so the instructor stopped the lesson to check the fastening before anyone continued down the slope.
senses.exampleChinese: 练习时一块滑雪板松了，教练停课检查固定件，才让人继续下坡。

senses.english: (v) to (n) talk with breath but no voice
senses.exampleEnglish: Please whisper while the recording is in progress, because the microphone can pick up conversations from across the room.
senses.exampleChinese: 录音时请小声说话，因为麦克风能录到房间另一头的谈话。

senses.english: speech made very quietly using breath rather than a full voice
senses.exampleEnglish: Her whisper was barely audible above the rain, so we moved closer before she explained where the others were waiting.
senses.exampleChinese: 雨声中她的耳语几乎听不见，我们靠近些才听她说其他人在哪等。

senses.english: towards the back part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: Passengers with large bags should use the rear entrance, where there is more space beside the door.
senses.exampleChinese: 携带大包的乘客应使用后门，那里门边空间更大。

senses.english: the back part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The bicycles were stored at the rear of the building, where a locked gate kept them separate from the public entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 自行车放在楼后，一道上锁的门把那里与公共入口隔开。

collocations.english: at the rear of the building

senses.english: to care for children or young animals until they are grown
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer explained how they rear the young animals, giving visitors a chance to ask about the work involved throughout the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 农场主解释如何饲养幼畜，让游客询问全年需要做哪些工作。

senses.english: list of dishes available at a restaurant
senses.exampleEnglish: The menu included several dishes we had never tried, so we asked the waiter to explain the ingredients.
senses.exampleChinese: 菜单上有几道我们没尝过的菜，因此我们请服务员解释食材。

senses.english: a list of choices shown on a computer or device
senses.exampleEnglish: Open the settings menu before starting the recording, then check that the correct microphone appears among the available options.
senses.exampleChinese: 录音前打开设置菜单，再确认可用选项中显示正确麦克风。

senses.english: a group of related animals or plant
senses.exampleEnglish: The project records which species return to the river after volunteers improve the water quality and restore nearby plants.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者改善水质并恢复附近植被后，项目记录哪些物种重返河流。

senses.english: round object circling the earth at night
senses.exampleEnglish: The moon rose above the lake as we walked back, lighting a narrow path through the dark trees.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们走回去时，月亮升到湖面上方，照亮穿过黑暗树林的一条小路。

phrases.english: extremely pleased or happy
phrases.exampleEnglish: She was over the moon when the school accepted her garden design, especially after she had revised it several times following feedback.
phrases.exampleChinese: 学校接受花园设计，她非常开心，尤其已按反馈改过几次。

phrases.english: very rarely
phrases.exampleEnglish: We only visit the coast once in a blue moon, so this time we planned several quiet walks rather than rushing between attractions.
phrases.exampleChinese: 我们极少去海边，因此这次安排安静散步，而不赶景点。

senses.english: concerning a true or likely nature
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop was closed and the lights were off, so presumably the owner had left earlier than usual.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店关门且灯也灭了，所以想必店主比平时早离开了。

senses.english: to ask the gods to protect someone or something
senses.exampleEnglish: At the ceremony, the village elder offered to bless the new hall before families gathered inside to celebrate.
senses.exampleChinese: 仪式上，村中长者提议为新礼堂祝福，然后各家聚在里面庆祝。

senses.english: to approve or support a plan or action
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee blessed the proposal after the organisers explained how they would pay for the project without reducing existing services.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者解释如何不削减现有服务而支付项目后，委员会支持提案。

phrases.chinese: 祝你安好；保佑你（喷嚏后用语）
phrases.english: a polite expression often said after someone sneezes
phrases.exampleEnglish: When her neighbour sneezed, she said bless you and passed him a tissue before returning to their discussion about the festival.
phrases.exampleChinese: 邻居打喷嚏，她说祝安并递纸巾，再继续谈节日。

senses.english: company that flies passengers in its planes
senses.exampleEnglish: The airline sent a message about the delay before we left home, which saved us an unnecessary early journey.
senses.exampleChinese: 航空公司在我们离家前发来延误信息，让我们不用过早白跑一趟。

senses.english: a change, addition, or improvement to something
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee suggested an amendment to the rules after members explained why the original wording could cause confusion.
senses.exampleChinese: 成员解释原文为何可能引起困惑后，委员会建议修改规则。

senses.english: an official change proposed or made to a law or formal document
senses.exampleEnglish: The amendment would require clearer information for customers, so members debated how businesses could provide it without creating unnecessary paperwork.
senses.exampleChinese: 修正案要求向顾客提供更清晰信息，因此成员讨论如何避免增加不必要文书。

senses.english: mother of your mother or father
senses.exampleEnglish: My grandmother taught me to repair small tears in clothing instead of throwing away things that could still be useful.
senses.exampleChinese: 祖母教我修补衣服的小破口，不要把仍然有用的东西扔掉。

senses.english: group of people who listen to information about something and make a decision
senses.exampleEnglish: The jury listened carefully to the evidence before discussing whether it supported the claims made during the trial.
senses.exampleChinese: 陪审团仔细听取证据，然后讨论它是否支持庭审中提出的主张。

phrases.english: a decision or judgment has not yet been reached
phrases.exampleEnglish: The jury is still out on the new timetable, because the school wants feedback from families before deciding whether to keep it.
phrases.exampleChinese: 新课表尚无定论，学校想先听家庭反馈再决定保留否。

senses.english: a situation where everyone works together to get something done
senses.exampleEnglish: The clean-up succeeded through close cooperation between residents and local shops, which provided supplies and refreshments for volunteers.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民与当地商店密切合作，商店为志愿者提供物资和茶点，清理活动因此成功。

senses.english: ordinary person who is not in the army
senses.exampleEnglish: The story follows a civilian whose daily routine changes when emergency workers use the school as a temporary shelter.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事围绕一名平民展开：救援人员将学校用作临时避难所后，他的日常生活改变了。

senses.english: something that is created from different parts to make something new
senses.exampleEnglish: Her musical composition combines sounds from the city with gentle piano passages, creating a feeling of movement and calm.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的音乐作品结合城市声响与轻柔钢琴段落，营造出动感与宁静。

senses.english: the parts or substances from which something is made
senses.exampleEnglish: The students compared the composition of different soils to understand why some plants grew better in one area than another.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生比较不同土壤成分，理解为何一些植物在某片地长得更好。

senses.english: a piece of writing produced as a learning exercise
senses.exampleEnglish: For homework, write a short composition about a place you know well, using details that help someone else imagine being there.
senses.exampleChinese: 作业写一篇熟悉地方的短文，用细节帮助别人想象置身其中。

senses.english: a small, flat piece of metal used as money
senses.exampleEnglish: He found an old coin beneath the floorboards and wondered how long it had been hidden there.
senses.exampleChinese: 他在地板下发现一枚旧硬币，想知道它在那里藏了多久。

senses.english: to invent a new word or expression
senses.exampleEnglish: The students coined a name for their project, choosing words that reflected both the local setting and their interest in wildlife.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生给项目创造了名称，用词同时体现当地环境和他们对野生动物的兴趣。

phrases.phrase: two sides of the same coin
phrases.english: two closely related aspects of the same situation
phrases.exampleEnglish: Freedom and responsibility are two sides of the same coin when students choose their own projects and explain how they will complete them.
phrases.exampleChinese: 学生自选项目并说明完成方式时，自由与责任是同一事物两面。

senses.english: without being affected or concerned by something difficult or troubling
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers continued regardless of the rain, because they wanted the playground ready before the children returned.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者不顾下雨继续工作，因为他们想在孩子们回来前修好游乐场。

senses.english: to look within something for a particular person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: I began to scan the crowded platform for my friend, looking for the bright scarf she usually wore.
senses.exampleChinese: 我开始在人群拥挤的站台寻找朋友，留意她常戴的鲜艳围巾。

senses.english: to look through written material quickly for general meaning or particular information
senses.exampleEnglish: Scan the article for dates before reading it carefully, so you can place the events in a clear order.
senses.exampleChinese: 仔细读文章前先快速找日期，便于把事件按清晰顺序排列。

senses.english: to use a device to make an image of something or examine its inside
senses.exampleEnglish: We scanned the old letters so that relatives living abroad could read them without risking damage to the fragile originals.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们扫描旧信，让国外亲属能阅读，又不损伤脆弱原件。

senses.english: an image or examination produced by a scanning device
senses.exampleEnglish: The scan revealed details that were difficult to see in the faded drawing, helping the museum describe it more accurately.
senses.exampleChinese: 扫描显示褪色图画中难看清的细节，帮助博物馆更准确描述。

senses.english: group of things of the same kind
senses.exampleEnglish: She placed a bunch of flowers on the table to welcome the friends who were visiting her new home.
senses.exampleChinese: 她把一束花放在桌上，欢迎到她新家做客的朋友。

senses.english: to gather things or people closely together
senses.exampleEnglish: The walkers bunched together near the narrow gate, so the guide asked smaller groups to pass through one at a time.
senses.exampleChinese: 步行者挤在窄门旁，导游让小组逐个通过。

senses.english: relating to a person's group based on inherited physical appearance
senses.exampleEnglish: The class discussed racial equality by examining how unfair treatment can affect people's opportunities in everyday life.
senses.exampleChinese: 全班通过探讨不公平待遇如何影响日常生活中的机会，讨论种族平等。

senses.english: to meet someone with friendly words and actions; to welcome
senses.exampleEnglish: The hosts stood near the entrance to greet each guest and explain where they could leave their coats.
senses.exampleChinese: 主人站在入口旁迎接每位客人，并说明可以把外套放在哪里。

senses.english: in a manner wishing something to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: Hopefully, the new path will make the park easier to reach for people who do not have cars.
senses.exampleChinese: 希望新小路能让没有汽车的人更容易到达公园。

senses.english: action taken to force a country to obey laws
senses.exampleEnglish: The report examined whether the economic sanction had achieved its aims or mainly affected ordinary people instead.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告研究这项经济制裁究竟实现了目标，还是主要影响了普通民众。

senses.english: official approval or permission
senses.exampleEnglish: The project cannot begin without the council's sanction, because the proposed work would change a protected part of the old building.
senses.exampleChinese: 项目未经议会正式批准不能开始，因为工程会改变老建筑受保护部分。

senses.english: to officially allow or approve something
senses.exampleEnglish: The school sanctioned the trip only after teachers explained the route and arrangements for helping students who might need extra support.
senses.exampleChinese: 教师说明路线和帮助有额外需求学生的安排后，学校才批准出游。

senses.english: to punish someone or an organisation by imposing restrictions
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisation may sanction members who repeatedly break the agreed rules, but it must first give them a fair chance to respond.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织可处罚反复违规成员，但须先公平给予回应机会。

senses.english: to make someone believe something that is not true
senses.exampleEnglish: The advertisement tried to trick readers into paying for information that was already available free on the official website.
senses.exampleChinese: 广告企图诱使读者为官网上已免费提供的信息付费。

senses.english: a clever method for doing something successfully
senses.exampleEnglish: The trick is to prepare all the materials before starting, so you do not need to interrupt the demonstration to find missing items.
senses.exampleChinese: 诀窍是开始前备齐材料，不用中断演示找缺少物品。

senses.english: an action intended to deceive or surprise someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The children planned a harmless trick for the celebration, making sure nobody would feel frightened or embarrassed when the surprise was revealed.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子为庆祝策划无害把戏，确保揭晓时没人害怕或难堪。

senses.english: a performance that seems impossible because its method is hidden
senses.exampleEnglish: The magician explained one simple trick after the show, allowing the children to practise it carefully before trying it on their families.
senses.exampleChinese: 演后魔术师解释简单戏法，孩子能先仔细练，再给家人表演。

phrases.english: to produce the result that is needed
phrases.exampleEnglish: Moving the lamp closer should do the trick, giving you enough light to read without changing the furniture in the whole room.
phrases.exampleChinese: 把灯移近应会奏效，不用改全屋家具便有足够阅读光。

phrases.english: a Halloween request for sweets made by children visiting homes
phrases.exampleEnglish: The children practised saying trick or treat before visiting the neighbours, while their parents explained which houses were taking part.
phrases.exampleChinese: 去邻家前孩子练不给糖就捣蛋，家长说明哪些家庭参加。

senses.english: section of writing that usually deals with one subject
senses.exampleEnglish: Each paragraph should develop one main idea, so readers can follow your argument without having to guess the connections.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个段落应展开一个主要观点，让读者无需猜测联系也能跟上论证。

senses.english: person, company, or object that creates things
senses.exampleEnglish: The furniture maker explained why choosing the right wood mattered as much as the design of the final piece.
senses.exampleChinese: 家具制造者解释，选对木材为何与成品设计同样重要。

senses.english: a sweet brown food made from cocoa beans
senses.exampleEnglish: We shared the chocolate after the long walk, saving a few pieces for the friends who would arrive later.
senses.exampleChinese: 长途步行后我们分享了巧克力，并留几块给晚些到来的朋友。

senses.english: excite to action
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher used an unexpected photograph to stimulate discussion before introducing the main question of the lesson.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先用一张出人意料的照片激发讨论，再介绍这节课的主要问题。

senses.english: band of material worn around a person's waist
senses.exampleEnglish: He tightened his belt before starting the walk, then checked that his small bag would not slip.
senses.exampleChinese: 他在开始步行前系紧腰带，然后检查小包不会滑落。

senses.english: a long area with a particular feature or type of land
senses.exampleEnglish: The green belt around the town gives residents access to open land while limiting how far new housing can spread.
senses.exampleChinese: 镇周绿带给居民开放空间，也限制新住房向外扩展。

senses.english: a strong flexible band that moves parts of a machine or carries objects
senses.exampleEnglish: The conveyor belt stopped when a box became stuck, so the staff cleared the area before restarting the system safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 箱子卡住使传送带停了，员工先清场再安全重启系统。

phrases.english: unfairly attacking a personal weakness
phrases.exampleEnglish: The comment about her family was below the belt, because the discussion was supposed to focus on the quality of the proposal.
phrases.exampleChinese: 评论她家人很不公平，因为讨论应聚焦提案质量。

phrases.english: to spend less because less money is available
phrases.exampleEnglish: You may need to tighten your belt for a few months if you want to save enough for the longer course.
phrases.exampleChinese: 想攒够长课程费用，可能需几个月节省开支。

senses.english: edible vegetable
senses.exampleEnglish: Each child planted a potato and recorded the changes until green leaves appeared above the soil several weeks later.
senses.exampleChinese: 每个孩子种下一颗土豆并记录变化，直到几周后绿叶钻出土壤。

phrases.english: a difficult or controversial issue that people are reluctant to handle
phrases.exampleEnglish: The parking proposal became a hot potato when residents disagreed about whether the town should favour visitors or people who lived there.
phrases.exampleChinese: 居民争城镇该优先游客还是居民时，停车提案成棘手问题。

senses.english: the telling of a story
senses.exampleEnglish: The film's narrative moves between past and present, gradually revealing why the two friends stopped speaking to each other.
senses.exampleChinese: 影片的叙事在过去和现在之间切换，逐渐揭示两位朋友为何不再交谈。

senses.english: piece of thin, soft paper
senses.exampleEnglish: She handed him a tissue after he spilled his drink, then helped move the papers away from the wet table.
senses.exampleChinese: 他打翻饮料后，她递给他一张纸巾，并帮忙把纸移离湿桌面。

senses.english: a group of similar cells that form part of a living body
senses.exampleEnglish: The diagram shows how muscle tissue differs from the surrounding material, helping students connect what they see with its function.
senses.exampleChinese: 图解显示肌肉组织与周围材料的区别，帮助学生联系形态与功能。

senses.english: almost not possible or does not happen
senses.exampleEnglish: We could barely hear the guide over the traffic, so we moved into a quieter street to listen.
senses.exampleChinese: 车流声中我们几乎听不见导游说话，于是移到安静些的街道听讲。

senses.english: to create something useful for the first time
senses.exampleEnglish: The children tried to invent a game that could be played indoors without needing expensive equipment or much space.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们试着发明一种室内游戏，不需昂贵设备或很大空间。

senses.english: traveling to new places (e.g., abroad, for vacations)
senses.exampleEnglish: Tourism supports many local businesses, but residents also want to protect the quiet places that attracted visitors originally.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅游业支撑许多当地企业，但居民也想保护最初吸引游客的宁静场所。

senses.english: someone who earns money doing something they are particularly good at
senses.exampleEnglish: After years of competing for fun, she became a pro and began travelling regularly to international tennis events.
senses.exampleChinese: 多年业余比赛后，她成为职业选手，开始定期前往国际网球赛事。

senses.english: an advantage or reason for supporting something
senses.exampleEnglish: We listed the pros and cons of each route before deciding which would suit both the younger and older walkers.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们列出各路线利弊，才决定哪条同时适合年轻与年长步行者。

senses.english: in favour of a person, policy, or idea
senses.exampleEnglish: The group is pro public transport, but members still want to check whether the proposed bus route will meet local needs.
senses.exampleChinese: 小组赞成公共交通，但仍想核查拟议公交线能否满足当地需求。

phrases.english: the advantages and disadvantages of something
phrases.exampleEnglish: Discuss the pros and cons of each option before voting, so quieter members can explain concerns that others may not have considered.
phrases.exampleChinese: 投票前讨论各选项利弊，让安静成员说明别人未想到的顾虑。

senses.english: steps that go from one level to another
senses.exampleEnglish: A loose stair near the top made us climb carefully until the owner had arranged for it to be repaired.
senses.exampleChinese: 顶部附近一阶楼梯松动，让我们小心攀登，直到主人安排好修理。

senses.english: to stop before doing something because you are unsure what to do
senses.exampleEnglish: Do not hesitate to ask for clarification if the instructions leave you unsure about what to do next.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果说明让你不确定下一步该做什么，请不要犹豫，直接询问。

senses.english: to make bright light
senses.exampleEnglish: The lamps shine through the windows after sunset, making the little station visible from across the dark field.
senses.exampleChinese: 日落后灯光从窗户透出，让人隔着黑暗田野也能看见小车站。

senses.english: to make something smooth and bright by rubbing it
senses.exampleEnglish: He shined his shoes before the interview, taking a little time to prepare the details that helped him feel more confident.
senses.exampleChinese: 面试前他擦亮鞋子，花些时间准备能让自己更自信的细节。

senses.english: to show great ability or perform extremely well
senses.exampleEnglish: She began to shine in group discussions once the class learned to listen instead of rushing to answer first.
senses.exampleChinese: 班上学会倾听而非抢答后，她开始在小组讨论中表现出色。

senses.english: a bright or smooth appearance on a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: The wooden table regained its shine after careful cleaning, although we kept the old marks that recorded years of family use.
senses.exampleChinese: 仔细清洁后木桌恢复光泽，但我们保留记录多年家庭使用的旧痕。

phrases.english: whatever happens, especially whatever the weather is like
phrases.exampleEnglish: The volunteers meet every Saturday, come rain or shine, because the animals need regular care even when the weather is unpleasant.
phrases.exampleChinese: 志愿者每周六风雨无阻会合，因为天气不好动物也需定期照顾。

senses.english: feeling in a person that makes him or her want to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Having a clear reason to study gave her the motivation to continue even when the exercises became more challenging.
senses.exampleChinese: 有明确的学习理由，让她即使练习更难时也有动力坚持。

senses.english: related to strong feelings of love between two people
senses.exampleEnglish: They planned a romantic dinner at home, choosing dishes that reminded them of the holiday when they first met.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们计划在家共进浪漫晚餐，选择能让他们想起初次相遇假期的菜肴。

senses.english: in a hard, steady, unchanging way
senses.exampleEnglish: Hold the ladder firmly while I climb, and tell me immediately if it begins to move at all.
senses.exampleChinese: 我爬梯子时请牢牢扶住，它一动就立刻告诉我。

senses.english: with strong confidence or determination
senses.exampleEnglish: She firmly believes that children learn more when they can ask questions freely and compare ideas without fear of being wrong.
senses.exampleChinese: 她坚信孩子能自由提问、不怕出错地比较想法时学得更多。

senses.english: inside part of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The interior walls were painted a pale colour so that the small rooms would feel brighter and more spacious.
senses.exampleChinese: 内墙涂成浅色，让小房间显得更明亮、更宽敞。

senses.english: the inside part of a building, object, or region
senses.exampleEnglish: The house's interior had changed completely, although its stone entrance still looked exactly as it had in the old photograph.
senses.exampleChinese: 房屋内部全变了，但石入口与旧照中仍一模一样。

senses.english: place in the body where food is broken down so your body can use it
senses.exampleEnglish: Her stomach began to rumble during the meeting because she had left home without eating any breakfast.
senses.exampleChinese: 开会时她的肚子开始咕咕叫，因为她没吃早餐就出了门。

senses.english: to accept or tolerate something very unpleasant
senses.exampleEnglish: I cannot stomach the way the article mocks beginners, especially when they are simply trying to understand an unfamiliar subject.
senses.exampleChinese: 我不能忍受文章嘲笑初学者，尤其他们只是在努力理解陌生主题。

phrases.english: a nervous feeling, especially before something important
phrases.exampleEnglish: Having butterflies in your stomach before a speech is common, but a familiar opening can help you begin despite feeling nervous.
phrases.exampleChinese: 演讲前紧张很常见，但熟悉开头能让你虽紧张仍开始。

senses.english: not in or at any place; no place
senses.exampleEnglish: We had nowhere to store the extra chairs until a neighbour offered us space in her empty garage.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到邻居提供空车库的空间，我们才有地方存放多余的椅子。

phrases.english: suddenly and unexpectedly
phrases.exampleEnglish: A question came out of nowhere during the discussion, opening a useful connection that nobody had noticed in the original plan.
phrases.exampleChinese: 讨论中突然冒出一个问题，打开原计划无人注意的有益联系。

phrases.english: to make no progress
phrases.exampleEnglish: We will get nowhere by repeating the same complaint, so let us agree on one change that we can test next week.
phrases.exampleChinese: 重复抱怨不会进展，不如商定下周能测试的一项改变。

senses.english: to wish or hope for something to happen or be true
senses.exampleEnglish: The family could only pray that the missing dog would return, while neighbours continued searching the nearby streets.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居继续在附近街道寻找时，一家人只能祈祷走失的狗能回来。

senses.english: to speak to a god in order to ask for help, give thanks, or express belief
senses.exampleEnglish: The family prayed together before the long journey, following a tradition that had connected different generations through times of change.
senses.exampleChinese: 长途旅行前全家一起祷告，遵循在变化中联系几代人的传统。

senses.english: sports competition to find the best player or team
senses.exampleEnglish: Winning the regional championship gave the young team confidence, although their coach reminded them to keep practising.
senses.exampleChinese: 赢得地区锦标赛让这支年轻队伍更有信心，但教练提醒他们继续练习。

senses.english: a person who works in another person's house and takes care of them
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel follows a servant who knows the household's routines better than the family that employs her.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说围绕一名仆人展开，她比雇用自己的那家人更熟悉家中日常。

phrases.english: a person employed by the government to carry out public work
phrases.exampleEnglish: The civil servant explained the application process patiently, making sure residents understood which documents were needed before they returned with their forms.
phrases.exampleChinese: 公务员耐心解释申请流程，让居民回来交表前明白需哪些文件。

senses.english: person moving to another country to live there
senses.exampleEnglish: As a recent immigrant, he found that joining a local sports club helped him build friendships and practise the language.
senses.exampleChinese: 作为新移民，他发现加入当地体育俱乐部有助于结交朋友和练习语言。

senses.english: amount that is more than necessary
senses.exampleEnglish: An excess of detail can make a report difficult to follow, even when each individual fact is accurate.
senses.exampleChinese: 细节过多会使报告难以理解，即使每个事实本身都准确。

senses.english: state of having many parts and not being simple
senses.exampleEnglish: The complexity of the task became clear when we realised that changing one part affected several other parts.
senses.exampleChinese: 当我们发现改动一处会影响其他几处时，任务的复杂性就显现了。

senses.english: a detail or feature that makes something difficult to understand or manage
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained the complexities of organising the festival, including transport, access, and the different needs of performers and visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释办节日的复杂因素，包括交通、通行和演者与访客的不同需求。

senses.english: something that is owed to someone else (e.g., a debt)
senses.exampleEnglish: The company listed each liability in its annual report so investors could understand how much it still owed.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司在年报中列出每项负债，让投资者了解它还有多少欠款。

senses.english: legal responsibility for something, especially damage or debt
senses.exampleEnglish: The agreement explains liability for damaged equipment, so both the club and borrowers understand their responsibilities before anything is taken home.
senses.exampleChinese: 协议说明设备损坏的责任，双方在物品借回家前都明白各自职责。

senses.english: a person or thing that creates a problem or disadvantage
senses.exampleEnglish: His habit of changing plans without telling anyone became a liability when the group had to coordinate work across several locations.
senses.exampleChinese: 小组须跨地点协调时，他改计划不告知的习惯成了累赘。

senses.english: in an unexpected way
senses.exampleEnglish: Surprisingly, the quieter students offered the most original ideas once the discussion moved into smaller, more relaxed groups.
senses.exampleChinese: 令人意外的是，讨论转入更轻松的小组后，平时安静的学生提出了最有创意的想法。

senses.english: to take something out of something else
senses.exampleEnglish: We used a simple tool to extract the broken piece without damaging the wooden frame around it.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们用一个简单工具取出断片，没有损坏周围的木框。

senses.english: a short part taken from a longer piece of writing or recording
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher read an extract from the novel before asking us to predict how the relationship between the characters might develop.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先读一段小说节选，再让我们预测人物关系可能如何发展。

senses.english: making a law, system, or plan start to happen or be used
senses.exampleEnglish: Successful implementation of the plan depends on giving volunteers clear instructions and enough time to practise their tasks.
senses.exampleChinese: 计划能否成功实施，取决于是否给志愿者清楚说明和足够练习任务的时间。

senses.english: a strong feeling not based on facts to believe one thing over another
senses.exampleEnglish: The writer tried to avoid bias by interviewing people with different views before describing the neighbourhood's changes.
senses.exampleChinese: 作者在描写街区变化前采访了观点不同的人，力图避免偏见。

senses.english: to unfairly influence a judgment or result
senses.exampleEnglish: The wording of a question can bias the answers, so we tested the survey with people who had different views.
senses.exampleChinese: 问题措辞会影响答案倾向，因此我们请观点不同的人试填调查。

senses.english: in a way that is not the same
senses.exampleEnglish: The two groups interpreted the photograph differently because each noticed details that the other group had overlooked.
